libraries.name: 1euroFilter
libraries.author: Géry Casiez
libraries.sentence: Algorithm to filter noisy signals for high precision and responsiveness.
libraries.paragraph: The 1€ filter uses a first order low-pass filter with an adaptive cutoff frequency: at low speeds, a low cutoff stabilizes the signal by reducing jitter, but as speed increases, the cutoff is increased to reduce lag. The algorithm is easy to implement, uses very few resources, and with two easily understood parameters, it is easy to tune. In a comparison with other filters, the 1€ filter has less lag using a reference amount of jitter reduction.

libraries.name: 1NCE Arduino Blueprint
libraries.author: 1NCE GmbH
libraries.sentence: Sample integration of 1NCE SDK with Arduino, providing demos for various features of 1NCE OS.
libraries.paragraph: The library demonstrates the usage of 1NCE OS Device Authenticator (COAP) and energy saver (CoAP/UDP). A Lwm2m client (with/without DTLS) using Eclipse wakaama is also provided

libraries.name: 24s02ya__M24SR02-Y

libraries.paragraph: This library provides functions to interact with 24s02ya__M24SR02-Y NFC chips*, including reading from NFC files or handling NDEF messages. It supports various file types such as NDEF, System, and CC files. *such chip was found on a Candy Washing machine

libraries.name: 2WD_Robot
libraries.author: mbrraghu
libraries.sentence: Library for 2WD robot with obstacle avoidance, line following, wall following, cliff detection, and bluetooth control
libraries.paragraph: Supports HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor, IR sensors (digital and analog), 5-sensor IR array for line following, and Cytron MDD3A motor driver with PWM/PWM and PWM/DIR modes

libraries.name: 3BC Language Virtual Machine
libraries.author: Rodrigo Dornelles <rodrigo@dornelles.me>
libraries.sentence: 3BC Language Virtual Machine
libraries.paragraph: is a low-level and easy-to-learn programming language that works in the form of a virtual machine similar to a computer from the 60s, but with a surprising architecture that has only 3 bits. Despite having an aspect to be an esoteric language, it has a good general use capability to solve computational problems and advantages with implementation in embedded and microcontrollers.

libraries.name: 72x40oled_lib
libraries.author: AbdulKus <ars1klas@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: A lightweight Arduino library for 72x40 OLED displays with the SSD1315 and SSD1306 controller, featuring pixel, text, and bitmap drawing, multiple fonts, rotation, and brightness control.
libraries.paragraph: This library provides an efficient and easy-to-use interface for 72x40 pixel OLED displays based on the SSD1315 or SSD1306 controller. It supports drawing pixels, rectangles, bitmaps, and text with several font sizes, including a compact 5x8 font. The library offers screen rotation, adjustable brightness, and low-power sleep mode. Designed for simple integration, it works out of the box with both standard Arduino boards and ATtiny85, making it ideal for compact and low-power projects. Example sketches are included to help you get started quickly.

libraries.name: 7Semi ADS7830
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>

libraries.paragraph: This library provides an interface to the ADS7830 ADC from Texas Instruments, supporting single-ended and differential analog inputs, internal reference selection, and 8-bit resolution via I2C.

libraries.name: 7Semi ADXL335 Accelerometer
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the ADXL335 analog 3-axis accelerometer module.
libraries.paragraph: This library reads analog voltage from the ADXL335 accelerometer and calculates acceleration in X, Y, and Z axes. Useful in robotics, motion tracking, and vibration monitoring.

libraries.name: 7Semi BME280
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino wrapper library for Bosch BME280 sensor (I2C + SPI).
libraries.paragraph: This library provides an Arduino-friendly interface for the Bosch Sensortec BME280 sensor API. Supports I2C and SPI communication, low-power forced measurements, and configuration for oversampling, filter and standby time.

libraries.name: 7Semi BME690
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the 7Semi BME690 sensor module (gas, pressure, temperature, humidity).
libraries.paragraph: Supports BME690 sensor over I2C and SPI. Includes functions to read gas resistance (VOC), temperature, humidity, and barometric pressure. Ideal for environmental and air quality sensing applications.

libraries.name: 7Semi BMI270
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the Bosch BMI270 IMU (7Semi wrapper)
libraries.paragraph: Provides easy initialization and sensor readout for the Bosch BMI270 IMU over I2C or SPI, ideal for embedded and ESP32/Arduino projects.

libraries.name: 7Semi BMI323
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Lightweight and efficient BMI323 IMU sensor library.
libraries.paragraph: Provides a clean and high-performance interface for Bosch BMI323 6-axis IMU over I2C and SPI. Supports accelerometer and gyroscope configuration, FIFO, interrupts, calibration, and sensor data processing. Designed for embedded efficiency and ease of use.

libraries.name: 7Semi BMP384
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Lightweight and efficient BMP384 pressure and temperature sensor library.
libraries.paragraph: Provides a clean, high-performance interface for Bosch BMP384 sensors over I2C and SPI. Includes support for FIFO, interrupts, filtering, oversampling, and altitude calculation. Designed for embedded efficiency and ease of use.

libraries.name: 7Semi BMP58x
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Lightweight BMP58x driver for Arduino (I2C/SPI) with beginner-friendly defaults.
libraries.paragraph: Arduino library for the Bosch Sensortec BMP58x barometric pressure sensor. Supports I2C and SPI on Arduino-core boards (ESP32/AVR/STM32/RP2040 etc). Includes safe default configuration via initSensor() so the sensor works out-of-box, plus helpers for OSR/ODR/IIR, interrupts, FIFO, OOR window, and NVM access. Optional I2C/SPI pin mapping is supported on ESP32 cores.

libraries.name: 7Semi BMV080
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for accurate particulate matter sensing using Bosch Sensortec BMV080
libraries.paragraph: Arduino wrapper around the official Bosch Sensortec BMV080 SDK. Users must provide Bosch SDK header and library files.

libraries.name: 7Semi BNO08x
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Minimal BNO08x IMU SHTP driver with pluggable I2C/SPI/UART transports.
libraries.paragraph: Provides a compact BNO08x (BNO080/BNO085/BNO086) driver focused on parsing sensor reports over the SH-2 Transport Protocol (SHTP). Includes transport adapters for I2C, SPI, and UART HDLC-style framing, plus simple feature-enable helpers and cached sensor getters.

libraries.name: 7Semi DAC7578
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino driver for Texas Instruments DAC7578 8-channel 12-bit I2C DAC.
libraries.paragraph: Lightweight production-grade driver for the TI DAC7578. Supports voltage and raw DAC writes, synchronous channel updates, LDAC register control, clear code register, and power-down modes. Includes internal channel caching for fast readback.

libraries.name: 7Semi ENS210
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: ENS210 temperature and humidity sensor library for Arduino.
libraries.paragraph: High-accuracy ENS210 temperature and humidity sensor library with CRC validation, single-shot and continuous modes, and Kelvin/Celsius/Fahrenheit/Absolute humidity calculations. Optimized for ESP32, AVR, and other Arduino-compatible platforms.

libraries.name: 7Semi HMC6343 Compass
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the HMC6343 3-axis digital compass sensor with tilt compensation.
libraries.paragraph: This library allows interfacing with the HMC6343 sensor over I2C to read heading, pitch, roll, magnetometer, accelerometer, and temperature values. It also supports calibration and configuration options, making it ideal for robotics, navigation, and embedded systems.

libraries.name: 7Semi ICM20948
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the 7Semi ICM-20948 9-axis IMU (Accel, Gyro, Mag, Temp).
libraries.paragraph: Supports both I2C and SPI communication, configurable DLPF, full-scale range, output data rate, and magnetometer access via internal I2C master. Includes clean example sketches for ESP32 and Arduino UNO.

libraries.name: 7Semi INA260
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the INA260 current, power, and bus voltage monitor over I2C.
libraries.paragraph: Provides easy APIs to read current (mA), power (mW), and bus voltage (mV) from the INA260 with configurable averaging and conversion times. Includes example sketches.

libraries.name: 7Semi LIS3DH
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for LIS3DH 3-axis accelerometer with I2C and SPI support.
libraries.paragraph: This library supports LIS3DH accelerometer over I2C and SPI with features like raw and g-unit acceleration, INT1/INT2 interrupts, ADC readings, and temperature measurement.

libraries.name: 7Semi MAX31855
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: MAX31855 thermocouple interface library for Arduino and ESP32.
libraries.paragraph: High-quality SPI driver for MAX31855 thermocouple-to-digital converter. Supports temperature reading in Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin. Includes fault detection and cold junction monitoring. Designed for Arduino, ESP32, and STM32 platforms.

libraries.name: 7Semi MLX90393
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: MLX90393 3-axis magnetometer library
libraries.paragraph: Lightweight and configurable Arduino library for the MLX90393 sensor. Supports magnetic field measurement (µT), configurable gain, resolution, OSR, filter, and ESP32 custom I2C pins.

libraries.name: 7Semi SHT4x
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the 7Semi SHT4x (SHT40/SHT41/SHT45) temperature and humidity sensor.
libraries.paragraph: Supports I2C communication for precise humidity and temperature data using SHT4x series sensors. Ideal for IoT and environmental sensing.

libraries.name: 7Semi STS3x
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the Sensirion STS3x digital temperature sensor.
libraries.paragraph: Provides an easy-to-use interface for the Sensirion STS3x temperature sensor over I2C. Supports single-shot and periodic measurements with CRC validation and configurable repeatability levels.

libraries.name: 7Semi STS4x
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for Sensirion STS4x digital temperature sensors over I2C.
libraries.paragraph: Lightweight and easy-to-use Arduino library for Sensirion STS4x temperature sensors. Supports single-shot measurements, CRC validation for data integrity, configurable repeatability (precision levels), and optional smoothing filter. Designed for Arduino, ESP32, and other I2C-compatible platforms.

libraries.name: 7Semi TMP11x
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for Texas Instruments TMP116/TMP117 high-accuracy temperature sensors.
libraries.paragraph: Supports TMP116 and TMP117 via I2C with temperature in C/F, configuration (conversion rate, averaging, modes), alert/therm settings, alert polarity, limits, offset, and EEPROM access. Compatible with Arduino, ESP32, and ESP8266.

libraries.name: 7Semi TMP23x
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for Texas Instruments TMP23x analog temperature sensors.
libraries.paragraph: Supports TMP235 and TMP236 analog temperature sensors with accurate voltage-to-temperature conversion, ADC abstraction, averaging, smoothing, and calibration features. Compatible with Arduino, ESP32, and ESP8266.

libraries.name: 7Semi VEML7700
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the VEML7700 ambient light sensor.
libraries.paragraph: This library provides an easy interface for the Vishay VEML7700 ambient light sensor. It supports lux measurement, white channel reading, interrupt configuration, power saving modes, and automatic gain/integration adjustment for accurate measurements across a wide light range.

libraries.name: 7Semi_AD569x
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for Analog Devices AD569x 16-bit DAC with I2C interface.
libraries.paragraph: This library provides easy control of AD569x family I2C DACs including raw 16-bit output writes, voltage-based output setting, power-down modes, internal/external reference control, gain configuration, and software reset. Supports write-only command operation with staged update (write input then update output).

libraries.name: 7Semi_AD849x
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for Analog Devices AD849x thermocouple amplifier modules.
libraries.paragraph: This library provides an easy-to-use interface for Analog Devices AD849x thermocouple amplifiers. It supports ADC voltage reading, temperature conversion in Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin, configurable offset voltage and sensitivity, ADC averaging, simple sensor connection checking, one-point calibration, and optional exponential (IIR) filtering for stable temperature measurements.

libraries.name: 7Semi_ADS126x
libraries.author: 7Semi <inof@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the Texas Instruments 7semi_ADS126x 32-bit ADC.
libraries.paragraph: Supports high-resolution differential and single-ended measurements over SPI using the ADS126x. Includes internal reference and VBIAS setup.

libraries.name: 7Semi_ADS1xx5
libraries.author: 7semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for Texas Instruments ADS1015 and ADS1115 16-bit ADC with I2C interface.
libraries.paragraph: This library allows easy access to all features of the ADS1015 and ADS1115 including single-ended and differential voltage readings, comparator threshold settings, and PGA gain selection. Supports both single-shot and continuous conversion modes.

libraries.name: 7Semi_BME68x
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for Bosch BME68x environmental sensor with I2C and SPI support.
libraries.paragraph: Provides temperature, humidity, pressure and gas resistance readings from the Bosch BME68x sensor. Supports I2C and SPI communication, heater configuration, sampling control and multiple heater profiles.

libraries.name: 7Semi_BMI330
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Lightweight BMI330 IMU driver for Arduino (I2C/SPI) with beginner-friendly defaults.
libraries.paragraph: Arduino library for the Bosch Sensortec BMI330 6-axis IMU (accelerometer + gyroscope + temperature). Supports I2C and SPI on Arduino-core boards (ESP32/AVR/STM32/RP2040 etc). Includes safe default configuration so the sensor works out-of-box, plus helpers for FIFO, interrupts, and BMI330 feature engine (step/tap/motion/orientation/flat/tilt).

libraries.name: 7Semi_BMP585
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Lightweight BMP585 driver for Arduino (I2C/SPI) with beginner-friendly defaults.
libraries.paragraph: Arduino library for the Bosch Sensortec BMP585 barometric pressure sensor. Supports I2C and SPI on Arduino-core boards (ESP32/AVR/STM32/RP2040 etc). Includes safe default configuration via initSensor() so the sensor works out-of-box, plus helpers for OSR/ODR/IIR, interrupts, FIFO, OOR window, and NVM access. Optional I2C/SPI pin mapping is supported on ESP32 cores.

libraries.name: 7Semi_BNO055
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Lightweight BNO055 driver (raw + minimal helpers) with optional configurable I2C pins.
libraries.paragraph: Supports orientation (Euler, quaternion), raw sensor data (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer), linear acceleration, gravity vector, sensor configuration, and calibration. Optimized for low flash usage across AVR, ESP32, STM32, RP2040 and more.

libraries.name: 7Semi_CO2TH
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: I2C driver for the 7Semi CO₂TH sensor with RHT compensation.
libraries.paragraph: Features: automatic I2C address scanning, product ID verification, continuous/single-shot measurement, CRC-8-verified RHT/pressure compensation, sleep/reset/conditioning/self-test helpers, and minimal examples for quick evaluation.

libraries.name: 7Semi_DS18B20
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Full-feature DS18B20 temperature sensor library using OneWire.
libraries.paragraph: Supports single and multiple DS18B20 sensors on one bus, alarm thresholds, programmable resolution (9-12 bit), parasite and external power modes, EEPROM functions, CRC checking, and strong pull-up for parasite mode.

libraries.name: 7Semi_HX711
libraries.author: 7semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Lightweight HX711 ADC library using manual bit-banging.
libraries.paragraph: This library reads raw 24-bit data from the HX711 load cell amplifier without external dependencies. Supports tare, scale calibration, and weight conversion.

libraries.name: 7Semi_INA219
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: 7Semi INA219 Precision Current and Power Monitor Driver.
libraries.paragraph: Fully featured INA219 driver with flexible calibration, full configuration control, and simple readout of voltage, current, and power in engineering units. Supports adjustable bus range, PGA, ADC averaging, and operating modes. No external dependencies beyond Wire.h.

libraries.name: 7Semi_ISM330DHCX
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the STMicroelectronics ISM330DHCX 6-axis IMU (accelerometer + gyroscope) over I2C.
libraries.paragraph: This library provides an easy interface to initialize the ISM330DHCX, configure accelerometer/gyroscope settings (ODR, range), read 3-axis accel and gyro data, and use FIFO features via I2C.

libraries.name: 7semi_L89HA
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Parse and extract GNSS data (GNRMC, GNGGA) from L89 GPS modules.
libraries.paragraph: This library parses NMEA sentences like $GNRMC and $GNGGA from L89 GNSS modules, and provides access to time, date, position, altitude, and speed data. Includes checksum validation and simple API.

libraries.name: 7Semi_LPS28DFW
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the LPS28DFW pressure sensor.
libraries.paragraph: This library provides an easy interface for the ST LPS28DFW pressure sensor. It supports pressure (hPa) and temperature (°C) measurement, configurable output data rate, averaging, FIFO, interrupts, and offset calibration.

libraries.name: 7Semi_MAX17048
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the MAX17048 fuel gauge IC.
libraries.paragraph: Supports battery voltage, state-of-charge, alerts, and quick-start/reset via I2C. Based on official datasheet and Adafruit reference.

libraries.name: 7Semi_MAX31856
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for MAX31856 thermocouple amplifier.
libraries.paragraph: This library provides an easy interface to the MAX31856 thermocouple-to-digital converter. It supports thermocouple configuration, temperature reading, fault detection, and threshold configuration.

libraries.name: 7Semi_MAX31865
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Driver for the MAX31865 RTD-to-digital converter.
libraries.paragraph: Flexible SPI (hardware/software) driver for the MAX31865 RTD converter IC. Supports PT100/PT1000, 2/3/4-wire configurations, fault detection, and temperature calculation using the Callendar–Van Dusen equation.

libraries.name: 7Semi_MCP23017
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Lightweight driver for the MCP23017 16-bit I²C GPIO expander.
libraries.paragraph: Supports GPIO direction, digital read/write, internal pull-ups, polarity inversion, and interrupt configuration. Works with any TwoWire I²C bus on Arduino, and ESP.

libraries.name: 7Semi_MMC5983MA
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the MMC5983MA 3-axis magnetometer with I2C support, temperature readout, and heading helpers.
libraries.paragraph: Supports I2C communication, reads 18-bit magnetometer XYZ and temperature, provides 2D and tilt-compensated heading helpers, and includes optional smoothing and calibration utilities.

libraries.name: 7Semi_NAU7802_24bit_ADC_WeightScale
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for NAU7802 24-bit ADC-based load cell and weigh scale modules.
libraries.paragraph: This library provides an easy-to-use interface for the NAU7802 24-bit low-noise ADC commonly used with load cells and weigh scale applications. It supports I2C communication, programmable gain amplifier (PGA), internal LDO configuration, selectable sample rates, raw ADC reading, averaging, tare (zeroing), scale calibration using a known weight, and stable weight measurement output. Designed for beginner-friendly and production-ready use on Arduino and ESP platforms.

libraries.name: 7Semi_OPT4048
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Lightweight OPT4048 color sensor driver for Arduino (I2C) with RGB + lux helpers.
libraries.paragraph: Arduino library for the TI OPT4048 color sensor. Reads X/Y/Z/W channels, provides a simple lux estimate, and converts to 8-bit sRGB output. Includes white-balance capture and dark-offset helpers for better color stability.

libraries.name: 7semi_SCD4x_CO2_Sensor
libraries.author: 7semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for SCD40/SCD41 CO₂ sensors with I2C interface.
libraries.paragraph: This library allows communication with Sensirion SCD4x sensors over I2C to measure CO₂ concentration, temperature, and humidity. Supports auto-calibration and low-power modes.

libraries.name: 7Semi_SGP4x
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for SGP40 and SGP41 gas sensors.
libraries.paragraph: I2C driver for SGP40 and SGP41 VOC and NOx sensors. Includes conditioning support, humidity compensation and helper index functions.

libraries.name: 7Semi_SHT4x_analog_Arduino-Library
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Simple analog library for Sensirion SHT4x-Analog humidity and temperature sensors.
libraries.paragraph: Reads analog RH/T outputs and converts them to %RH and °C/°F for all supported SHT40I-Analog variants (HD1B, ID1B, JD1B, KD1B, LD1B).

libraries.name: 7Semi_TMAG5273
libraries.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
libraries.sentence: Arduino driver for Texas Instruments TMAG5273 3-axis Hall-effect magnetic sensor.
libraries.paragraph: Arduino library for the TMAG5273 magnetic sensor including magnetic field measurement, temperature sensing, angle calculation, threshold detection, interrupts, configurable averaging and power modes.

libraries.name: 7Semi-OPT3004-Digital-Ambient-Light-Sensor-Arduino-Library
libraries.author: 7Semi
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the OPT3004 ambient light sensor with lux output.

libraries.name: ACAN2517

Compatible with ACAN, ACAN2515, ACAN2515Tiny, ACAN2517FD libraries. Default configuration sends and receives any frame – no default filter to provide. Reception filters (up to 32) can be easily defined. Runs on ESP32 from version 1.1.0. For a library in CANFD mode, see the ACAN2517FD library.

libraries.name: ACAN2517FD

Compatible with ACAN, ACAN2515, ACAN2517 libraries, with ACAN_T4 library from version 2.1.0. Default configuration sends and receives any frame – no default filter to provide. Reception filters (up to 32) can be easily defined. Compatible with ESP32 from version 1.1.0.

libraries.name: AceButton
libraries.author: Brian T. Park <brian@xparks.net>
libraries.sentence: An adjustable, compact, event-driven button library that handles debouncing and dispatches events to a user-defined event handler.
libraries.paragraph: Supported events are Pressed, Released, Clicked, DoubleClicked, LongPressed, and RepeatPressed. Timing parameters, event activation, and event suppression can be configured at compile-time or run-time. Optimized for compact memory consumption. Supports buttons connected directly to digital pins, multiple buttons connected to digital pins through a binary encoder, or multiple buttons connected to analog pins through a resistor ladder.

libraries.name: AceCommon
libraries.author: Brian T. Park <brian@xparks.net>
libraries.sentence: Small low-level classes and functions for Arduino: incrementMod(), decToBcd(). strcmp_PP(), PrintStr<N>, PrintStrN, printPad{N}To(), printIntAsFloat(), TimingStats, formUrlEncode(), FCString, KString, hashDjb2(), binarySearch(), linearSearch(), isSorted(), reverse(), and so on.
libraries.paragraph: The classes and functions have no external dependencies so that they can be easily reused in other libraries.

libraries.name: AceCRC
libraries.author: Brian T. Park <brian@xparks.net>
libraries.sentence: Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) algorithms: crc8, crc16ccitt, crc16modbus, crc32.
libraries.paragraph: Programmatically converted from C99 code generated by https://pycrc.org to Arduino C++. For each CRC algorithm, 4 variants are available: The 'bit' variant uses brute force bit-by-bit loop (smallest and slowest); the 'nibble' variant uses a 4-bit table (potentially good balance between size and speed); `nibblem` variant is the same as `nibble` but 1.9X-2.7X faster on the ESP8266; and the 'byte' variant uses an 8-bit table (largest but fastest).

libraries.name: AceMenu
libraries.author: Johny Hoops <johnyhoops@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: A library that makes coding a user Menu a breeze.
libraries.paragraph: Uses a simple 3/4 button navigation system

libraries.name: AceRoutine
libraries.author: Brian T. Park <brian@xparks.net>
libraries.sentence: A low-memory, fast-switching, cooperative multitasking library using stackless coroutines on Arduino platforms.
libraries.paragraph: Supported macros include COROUTINE(), COROUTINE_BEGIN(), COROUTINE_YIELD(), COROUTINE_DELAY(), COROUTINE_AWAIT(), COROUTINE_LOOP(), and COROUTINE_END(). Verified to work on AVR (Nano, Uno, etc), SAMD21, STM32, Teensy ARM, ESP8266 and ESP32.

libraries.name: AceSegment
libraries.author: Brian T. Park <brian@xparks.net>
libraries.sentence: Library for rendering seven segment LED modules using the TM1637, TM1638, MAX7219, HT16K33, or 74HC595 controller chips.
libraries.paragraph: Hardware-dependent code is separated from the hardware-agnostic code so that applications can support different LED modules with minimal changes. Various writer classes provide rendering of numbers, temperature, clock digits, and strings. Brightness control is available on most LED modules. Some LED modules support brightness on a per-digit basis.

libraries.name: AceSegmentWriter
libraries.author: Brian T. Park <brian@xparks.net>
libraries.sentence: Write decimal numbers, hex numbers, temperature, clock digits, characters, and strings to the seven segment LED modules supported by the AceSegment library.
libraries.paragraph: Provides PatternWriter, NumberWriter, ClockWriter, TemperatureWriter, CharWriter, StringWriter, LevelWriter, and StringScroller.

libraries.name: AceSorting
libraries.author: Brian T. Park <brian@xparks.net>
libraries.sentence: Various sorting algorithms for Arduino, including Bubble Sort, Insertion Sort, Selection Sort, Shell Sort (3 versions), Comb Sort (4 versions), Quick Sort (3 versions).
libraries.paragraph: Provides 2 variants of each algorithm: a simple variant which sorts in ascending order using the implicit less-than operator, and a three-argument variant that accepts a function pointer or lambda expression to sort using a user-defined sorting function.

libraries.name: AceSPI
libraries.author: Brian T. Park <brian@xparks.net>
libraries.sentence: Unified interface for selecting hardware or software SPI implementations on Arduino platforms.
libraries.paragraph: Provides HardSpiInterface, HardSpiFastInterface, SimpleSpiInterface, and SimpleSpiFastInterface.

libraries.name: AceTime
libraries.author: Brian T. Park <brian@xparks.net>
libraries.sentence: Date, time, timezone classes for Arduino supporting the full IANA TZ Database to convert epoch seconds to date and time components in different time zones.
libraries.paragraph: Calculates UTC offsets and DST transitions of all timezones from the IANA TZ (Olson) Database. The bulk of the TZ Database can fit inside the 32kB flash size limit of an 8-bit AVR processor.

libraries.name: AceTimeClock
libraries.author: Brian T. Park <brian@xparks.net>
libraries.sentence: Clock classes for Arduino that provide an auto-incrementing count of seconds since a known epoch which can be synchronized from external sources such as an NTP server, a DS3231 RTC chip, or an STM32 RTC chip.
libraries.paragraph: This is a companion library to the AceTime library whose epoch defaults to 2050-01-01T00:00:00 UTC. This allows time zone calculations to be valid from the year 2000 to 2100 which matches the range of many hardware RTC chips that use a 2-digit year offset from the year 2000.

libraries.name: AceTMI
libraries.author: Brian T. Park <brian@xparks.net>
libraries.sentence: Interfaces for communicating with the TM1637 and TM1638 LED controllers on Arduino platforms.
libraries.paragraph: Provides SimpleTmi1637Interface, SimpleTmi1637FastInterface, SimpleTmi1638Interface, and SimpleTmi1638FastInterface.

libraries.name: AceUtils
libraries.author: Brian T. Park <brian@xparks.net>
libraries.sentence: Useful Arduino utilities which are too small as separate libraries, but complex enough to be shared among multiple projects, and often have external dependencies to other libraries.
libraries.paragraph: Since they have external dependencies, they cannot be added to the AceCommon library. Utilities include: AceUtilsCrcEeprom, AceUtilsCli, AceUtilsStm32BufferedEeprom.

libraries.name: AceWire
libraries.author: Brian T. Park <brian@xparks.net>

libraries.paragraph: Provides 8 adapter interfaces (TwoWireInterface, FeliasFoggWireInterface, MarpleWireInterface, RaemondWireInterface, SeeedWireInterface, TestatoWireInterface, ThexenoWireInterface, TodbotWireInterface).

Moreover, they are much more precise (certainly depending on clock frequency accuracy) than other software-based PWM using millis() or micros(). That's necessary if you need to control devices requiring high precision. Now you can change the PWM settings on-the-fly

libraries.sentence: A library that allows writing and highlighting code in local language.
libraries.paragraph:
Provides localised aliases for keywords, constants, methods, functions, structures and Arduino API. Includes keywords.txt file for syntax colouring.

It is meant for mentors who want to show the joy of programming to young learners, by eliminating spoken language barrier.

Example:
auto distance = radar.ping_cm();
if (distance < 15) { delay(500); }

Translates into Polish:
niech odleglosc = radar.ping_cm();
jezeli (odleglosc < 15) { czekaj(500); }

libraries.sentence: Simple WiFiManager for Blynk and ESP32 with or without SSL, configuration data saved in either SPIFFS or EEPROM. Enable inclusion of both ESP32 Blynk BT/BLE and WiFi libraries. Then select one at reboot or run both. Eliminate hardcoding your Wifi and Blynk credentials and configuration data saved in either LittleFS, SPIFFS or EEPROM. Using AsyncWebServer instead of WebServer, with WiFi networks scanning for selection in Configuration Portal.
libraries.paragraph: By design, Blynk user can run ESP32 boards with either WiFi or BT/BLE by using different sketches, and have to upload / update firmware to change. This library enables user to include both Blynk BT / BLE and WiFi libraries in one sketch, run both WiFi and BT/BLE simultaneously, or select one to use at runtime after reboot. This library also supports (auto)connection to MultiWiFi and MultiBlynk, dynamic custom as well as static parameters in Config Portal. Eliminate hardcoding your Wifi and Blynk credentials and configuration data saved in either LittleFS, SPIFFS or EEPROM. Optional default Credentials to be autoloaded into Config Portal to use or change instead of manually input. Static STA IP and DHCP Hostname as well as Config Portal AP channel, IP, SSID, Password can be configured. DoubleDetectDetector feature permits entering Config Portal as requested. Now with scanning of WiFi networks for selection in Configuration Portal.

libraries.name: Button_TT

libraries.paragraph: Differentiate the output when the state does not change and when the state changes. Using this state, you can easily program it to act only once when the button's state changes. [Korean]상태가 변하지 않았을 때, 상태가 변했을 때의 출력을 다르게 해줍니다. 이 상태를 이용하여 버튼의 상태가 변했을 때 한 번만 동작하도록 쉽게 프로그래밍이 가능합니다.

libraries.name: ButtonControl
libraries.author: Fellipe Couto <fellipe.couto@yahoo.com.br>

libraries.paragraph: Library to control push button click times.

libraries.name: ButtonDebounce
libraries.author: Maykon L. Capellari <maykonluiscapellari@gmail.com>

libraries.name: ButtonFever

libraries.name: ButtonnIRQ

libraries.name: ButtonPoll
libraries.author: Ulywae <ulywae@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: A lightweight, non-blocking input handler for buttons and selectors with event-based callbacks.
libraries.paragraph: ButtonPoll is an efficient input engine using 32-bit masking to handle up to 32 pins. It supports momentary buttons, selectors (toggle), and repeat patterns with a clean event contract system (Press, Release, Selector ON/OFF).

libraries.name: ButtonPoll_CW

libraries.name: ButtonSense

libraries.name: ButtonSuite
libraries.author: Lance A. Endres <lendres@fifthrace.com>
libraries.sentence: A library for using a simple mechanical push (momentary) button as a momentary button, a latching button, a counter, an enumerator, and more.
libraries.paragraph: The library allows a mechanical momentary button to be used as a virtual button with different functionality.  The library implements the behavior of a momentary button, a latching button, a counter, an enumerator, and more.  It also makes it very easy to develop buttons with your own custom behavior.  The Bounce2 library is used to add debouncing functionality.  Note that because some input devices like optical sensors or limit switches are functionally equivilent to tactile buttons, they can also be used with this library.

libraries.name: ButtonToSwitch
libraries.author: Gabriel D. Goldman <gdgoldman67@hotmail.com>
libraries.sentence: Implement simple to complex switches out of simple buttons -or any other momentary digital input signal- this library with an easy consistent API will take care of debouncing, deglitching, toggle on-off, keep activation times in a completely unnatended manner.
libraries.paragraph: This Arduino library includes classes that lets you implement all kind of switches out of simple buttons (Momentary Push Buttons or MPBs), PIR sensors, RFID readers or any other source of momentary digital signals. Add any kind of switch to a project by using simple MPBs and this library to simulate the internal mechanism of each of them, starting from a Debounced Push Button and extending to Delayed Start Push Button, Toggle (Latched) Push Button, Time Latched Push Button, External Release Latched Push Button, Staircase Timed Button, On/Off/Dimmers, and more... The library gives the embedded behavior to build more complex switches classes by simple composition: menu panels, rotary enum switches, etc.  Now includes on-line simulations for most of the example files (simulator provided by WOKWI.com)

libraries.name: ButtonToSwitch_ESP32

libraries.paragraph: This Arduino-Esp32 library includes classes that lets you implement all kind of switches out of simple buttons (Momentary Push Buttons or MPBs). Add any kind of switch to a project by using simple MPBs and this library to simulate the internal mechanism of each of them, starting from a Debounced Push Button and extending to Delayed Start Push Button, Toggle (Latched) Push Button, Time Latched Push Button, External Release Latched Push Button, Staircase Timed Button, On/Off/Dimmers, and more...

libraries.name: Buzz
libraries.author: Connor Nishijima
libraries.sentence: AC/static electricity-based motion detection using only the ADC and a wire!
libraries.paragraph: By monitoring the amplitude of AC electricity waveforms in the air for changes, Buzz provides motion detection using only a wire!

libraries.name: Buzzer

libraries.sentence: Allows Arduino/Genuino boards to simplify the use of the Buzzer.
libraries.paragraph:
This library simplify the use of a Buzzer.
It contains many function to manage a Buzzer.

libraries.name: BuzzerManager
libraries.author: baaaaan1
libraries.sentence: A library to manage multiple buzzers with flexible beep control.
libraries.paragraph: A simple library for managing multiple buzzers, providing non-blocking beep sequences with adjustable patterns and enhanced state management.

libraries.name: BuzzerMelody
libraries.author: Jean Elias <jmelabs33@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: This library provides a simple solution for playing one or more melodies on piezoelectric passive buzzers using the arduino core tone function in a non-blocking way.
libraries.paragraph: This library provides a simple solution for playing one or more melodies on piezoelectric passive buzzers using the arduino core tone function in a non-blocking way.

libraries.name: BuzzerPIO_RP2040
libraries.author: Ângelo Moisés Alves
libraries.sentence: Ultrasonic PWM tone generation for passive buzzers using the RP2040 PIO coprocessor.
libraries.paragraph: Dual state-machine architecture: SM1 generates an ultrasonic PWM carrier (~95 kHz) for distortion-free volume control, SM2 gates it at the audible frequency. Uses only 4 PIO instructions, auto-probes both PIO blocks, zero DMA, zero IRQ handlers. Multi-core safe via hardware spinlock. Coexists with OneWirePIO, DHT22PIO, and CYW43 WiFi. Non-blocking melody sequencing via hardware alarm chain with completion callback. Pause/resume support. Perceptually linear volume curve. Drop-in replacement for v1.x/v2.x.

libraries.name: BuzzerXCR
libraries.author: X-croot <unuvarcan111@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: Advanced buzzer control library for Arduino boards.
libraries.paragraph: BuzzerXCR is an advanced and flexible library to control passive buzzers. It supports PWM-based volume control, LED feedback, tone distortion effects (slow, normal, fast), fade-in/out, glissando, melody playback, and serial terminal interaction. Ideal for alarms, sound feedback, or musical output.

libraries.name: BuzzKill
libraries.author: Todd E. Stidham <baremetal6502@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: This library provides a simple interface for controlling the BuzzKill Sound Effects board.
libraries.paragraph: The library can utilize either an SPI or I2C (TWI) connection, and handles all low-level communications so that the user can concentrate on program functionality instead of technical details.

libraries.name: BY8X01-16P Audio Module Library

libraries.paragraph: This library allows communication with boards running a BY8001-16P or BY8301-16P audio module. It supports the full feature set of the BY8X01-16P chipset such as queued combination playback, indexed folder/file playback, loop playback mode, equalizer profile, spot insertion play, etc.

libraries.paragraph: Designed to solve the pain point of passing dynamic arrays between functions without copying. It uses move semantics for zero-copy transfers and safe memory management, making it ideal for serial protocols and communication tasks.

libraries.name: ByteConvert
libraries.author: Martin Dagarin
libraries.sentence: Library for converting variables to bytes and reverse
libraries.paragraph: Have you ever wanted to transmit int, short, long, double or any other numeric type over I2C, SPI, serial or other protocol or bus, but you converted variable to string to be able to transmit it char by char? This library enables you to convert any numeric value to bytes or the other way around and you can also print array of bytes.

libraries.name: Byteduino

libraries.paragraph: Connect to a hub, send payments, post datafeeds, cosign transactions, exchange messages with Obyte wallets through encrypted chat.

libraries.name: ByteFrame
libraries.author: Maximiliano Ramirez <maximiliano.ramirezbravo@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: Header-only frame delimiting library with zero dynamic memory allocation.
libraries.paragraph: Delimits packets over raw byte streams (UART, RS-485, radios, TCP) using COBS encoding, a selectable CRC (none, CRC8, CRC16 or CRC32) integrity check and a single 0x00 delimiter. Includes a compile-time worst-case size helper (getMaxEncodedSize) and an incremental fixed-buffer Decoder with per-cause error counters. Pairs naturally with BytePack for type-safe payloads.

libraries.name: BytePack
libraries.author: Maximiliano Ramirez <maximiliano.ramirezbravo@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: Header-only message serialization library with zero dynamic memory allocation.
libraries.paragraph: Plain structs with a single io() member function drive serialization, deserialization and compile-time size counting. Includes quantized values (Quant), length-prefixed payloads (Bytes), [ID][VERSION] message headers and a frame dispatch helper. Explicit little-endian wire format with no padding, portable across architectures. Pairs naturally with ByteFrame to delimit messages over a raw stream.

libraries.name: ConsumerKeyboard
libraries.author: Sach B. Jankharia, Rupak Poddar
libraries.sentence: Extends the Arduino HID library to support consumer device keys.
libraries.paragraph: This library extends the Arduino HID library, enabling the emulation of consumer device keys—such as play, pause, volume control, and more—on compatible microcontrollers. It facilitates the integration of multimedia key functionalities into your Arduino projects.

libraries.name: ContinuousStepper
libraries.author: Benoit Blanchon
libraries.sentence: An Arduino library to spin stepper motors in continuous motions.
libraries.paragraph: Contrary to other stepper libraries, this one doesn't provide any function to move the shaft at a specific angle. Instead, it provides one function to spin the shaft at a specific speed. It smoothly accelerates and decelerates when the speed changes. Optionally runs with TimerOne, TimerThree, or TeensyTimerTool.

libraries.name: ContinuousStepper_Generic
libraries.author: Khoi Hoang <khoih.prog@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: This library enables you to use Hardware-based PWM channels on Generic boards to use PWM to control continuous Stepper Motor
libraries.paragraph: The most important feature is they're purely hardware-based PWM channels, supporting very high PWM frequencies. Therefore, their executions are not blocked by bad-behaving functions or tasks. This important feature is absolutely necessary for mission-critical tasks. These hardware-based PWMs, still work even if other software functions are blocking. Moreover, they are much more precise (certainly depending on clock frequency accuracy) than other software-based PWM using ISR, millis() or micros(). That's necessary if you need to control devices requiring high precision

libraries.name: Control Surface
libraries.author: Pieter P
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for creating MIDI controllers and other MIDI devices.
libraries.paragraph: At its core, the library features a flexible MIDI abstraction layer with support for serial 5-pin DIN MIDI, MIDI over USB, MIDI over BLE, etc. These MIDI interfaces are compatible with a wide range of Arduino boards and are useful in any Arduino MIDI project. In addition to MIDI input/output, Control Surface also provides easy-to-use utilities intended for building MIDI controllers, supporting controls that send MIDI messages ─ like potentiometers, push buttons, rotary encoders, etc. ─ and controls that react to incoming MIDI messages ─ LEDs, displays, and so on. More advanced controls that combine MIDI input and output ─ such as motorized faders ─ are supported as well.

libraries.name: DCCpp

libraries.paragraph: Currently this library uses MQTT interface to connect to the DCD hub and update particular thing property. In future release there will be more functionality added to create a new property or search for exising one.

libraries.name: DcDccNanoController

libraries.name: DCF77
libraries.author: Thijs Elenbaas
libraries.sentence: Read and decode the atomic time broadcasted by the DCF77 radiostation.
libraries.paragraph: The DCF77 library has been designed to work in conjunction with Arduino Time library and allows a sketch to get the precise CET time and date as a standard C time_t. PLEASE NOTE: samples require Time and TimeZone libraries.

libraries.name: dcf77_xtal
libraries.author: Udo Klein dcf77@blinkenlight.net
libraries.sentence: DCF77 decoder with excellent noise tolerance.
libraries.paragraph: Attention: this library requires a crystal based Arduino. Read the Hardware Incompatibilities Section of the documentation for more details.

libraries.name: DCF77Decode
libraries.author: Krause Michael
libraries.sentence: Focusing on clean code, this library implements almost the entire public DCF77 standard in C.
libraries.paragraph: This Arduino library implements all bits publicly specified by the „Physikalisch-Technische Bundesanstalt“ that are within a 60 second bit stream of the time signal, with the exception of the leap second. It also checks for transmission errors via even parity and queries the 15 bit ("call bit") to rule out problems with the transmitter.

libraries.name: DCF77FreeRTOS

libraries.sentence: DCF77 atomic clock receiver with FreeRTOS task integration for ESP32.
libraries.paragraph: Asynchronous DCF77 time signal decoder running in its own FreeRTOS task. Provides automatic signal classification, error handling, and event-driven time synchronization. Designed to work seamlessly alongside GPS or NTP fallback time sources.

libraries.name: DCF77RX
libraries.author: dac1e
libraries.sentence: Receive DCF77 frames and convert them to std::tm structure.
libraries.paragraph: Use a DCF77 receiver on your Arduino to obtain time and date.

libraries.name: DCMotor

libraries.name: DCMotor_L9110

libraries.name: DCMotorController

libraries.paragraph: This library provides a simple interface to control DC motors, it is meant to interact with either single wire PWM motor drivers, like the SparkMAX, or three wire (PWM, forward and reverse) motor drivers such as L298N.

libraries.name: DCS-BIOS

libraries.name: DCT532

libraries.name: DDBot

libraries.name: DDC-CI VPC library

libraries.paragraph: A simple library that implements an automatic DDNS Update Client for SAM DUE, nRF52, SAMD21/SAMD51, STM32F/L/H/G/WB/MP1, AVR Mega, megaAVR, Teensy, RP2040-based RASPBERRY_PI_PICO, WT32_ETH01, Portenta_H7, etc. besides ESP8266/ESP32, using ESP8266-AT/ESP32-AT WiFi, WiFiNINA, Ethernet W5x00, ENC28J60, LAN8742A or Teensy NativeEthernet. It is designed to be light-weight and currently supports DuckDNS, No-ip, DynDNS, Dynu, enom, all-inkl, selfhost.de, dyndns.it, strato, freemyip, afraid.org, OVH.com.  Deprecated ipv4bot.whatismyipaddress.com has been replaced with ifconfig.me

libraries.name: Dynamixel_Servo
libraries.author: Michael Krzyzaniak<mkrzyzan@asu.edu>
libraries.sentence: Dynamixel_Servo is an Arduino compatible library for controlling Dynamixel MX and RX series servos.
libraries.paragraph: This module presents a high-level interface and a low-level interface for manipulating the servo's registers. The high-level interface looks up the width (one or two bytes) of the specified value and manipulates all relevant registers (low byte and high byte) as a single value. The high-level interface also performs automatic conversions between the raw values defined in the servo's datasheet, and physical values such as radians, radians-per-second, Amperes, Volts, baud, microseconds, degrees-Celcius, percent (of the motor's maximum torque) etc... as appropriate to the value. The down-side is that the high-level interface hogs several kilobytes of code space, as the result of using floating-point math and having some large-ish lookup tables. Therefore a low-level interface is provided that allows more straightforward access to the servo's registers using raw values, which may optionally be converted to and from physical values using the provided functions. Using the low-level interface and raw values may save several kilobytes of code space (The compiler won't compile functions that aren't used). The low-level interface also provides the capability to access several of the servo's values in a single command using the xxx_raw_page functions.

EEPROMAdapter

libraries.name: ESP_EEPROM
libraries.author: j-watson <j-watson@ntlworld.com>
libraries.sentence: An improved EEPROM library for ESP8266
libraries.paragraph: The ESP8266 family doesn't have genuine EEPROM memory so it is normally emulated by using a section of flash memory.  With the standard library, the sector needs to be re-flashed every time the changed EEPROM data needs to be saved.  For small amounts of EEPROM data this is very slow and will wear out the flash memory more quickly.  This library writes a new copy of your data when you save (commit) it and keeps track of where in the sector the most recent copy is kept.  The flash sector only needs to be erased when there is no more space for copies in the flash sector.  You can keep track of this yourself to do a time-consuming erase when most convenient or the library will do it for you when there is no more space for the data when you commit it.

libraries.name: ESPPubSubClientWrapper
libraries.author: Erik Foltin
libraries.sentence: A wrapper class for the MQTT PubSubClient library by Nick O'Leary for ESP8266/ESP32.
libraries.paragraph: MQTT is a lightweight messaging protocol ideal for small devices. This library wraps the PubSubClient with simplified API for automatic reconnect and specific callbacks to specific topics.

libraries.name: Espressif ESP32 Azure IoT Kit Sensors
libraries.author: Ewerton Scaboro da Silva
libraries.sentence: Unofficial Arduino library for interacting with sensors in the Espressif ESP32 Azure IoT Kit development board.
libraries.paragraph: Unofficial Arduino library for interacting with sensors in the Espressif ESP32 Azure IoT Kit development board.

libraries.name: EspSaveCrash

libraries.sentence: Automatically saves exception details and stack trace to flash in case of ESP8266 crash.
libraries.paragraph: EspSaveCrash is a handy little library that will keep catching and saving crash information to ESP8266 flash in case it fails due to exception or software WDT. For more details please visit https://github.com/krzychb/ESPSaveCrash

libraries.name: ESPSerialFlasher
libraries.author: Winner10920
libraries.sentence: [EXPERIMENTAL] Flash the WiFiNiNa module on your arduino nano 33 iot

libraries.name: ESPShell
libraries.author: Viacheslav Logunov <vvb333007@gmail.com>

libraries.paragraph: ESP32Shell is a self-sufficient library (no deps) which hooks on a startup process and deploys command line interface with basic functions: uart, i2c, rmt, filesystems, GPIO manipulation, sketch pause/continue and so on. Suitable both for C and C++ projects.

libraries.name: EspSimpleRemoteUpdate
libraries.author: Patrick Lapointe <patrick.lapointe@hotmail.ca>
libraries.sentence: Simple remote update handling for ESP8266/ESP32
libraries.paragraph: Allow to easily set a Web updater and/or OTA update. Intended to be used with an ESP8266 or ESP32.

libraries.name: EspSimpleWifiHandler
libraries.author: Patrick Lapointe <patrick.lapointe@hotmail.ca>
libraries.sentence: Simple and automatic WiFi handling for ESP8266/ESP32
libraries.paragraph: This library automatically manage a WiFi connection. Intended to be used with an ESP8266 or ESP32.

libraries.name: EspSleep
libraries.author: AlexGyver <alex@alexgyver.ru>
libraries.sentence: Library for esp8266 unlimited deep sleep period
libraries.paragraph: Library for esp8266 unlimited deep sleep period

libraries.name: ESPSmartDash
libraries.author: Manish KD
libraries.sentence: Automatic Web Dashboard for ESP32 and ESP8266
libraries.paragraph: Create IoT dashboards with toggles, sliders and sensor gauges using a lightweight web interface.

libraries.name: EspSoftwareSerial
libraries.author: Dirk Kaar, Peter Lerup
libraries.sentence: Implementation of the Arduino software serial for ESP8266/ESP32.

libraries.name: ESPStringTemplate
libraries.author: Dale Giancono <d.giancono@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: Lightweight string templating library for building static web pages on the ESP8266
libraries.paragraph: ESPStringTemplate is a lightweight library created to make static web page generation simple and easy to understand on the ESP8266. It was created in an attempt to make building customisable and scalable web pages fast and easy while using statically allocated buffers to store the created web pages.

libraries.name: ESPSupabase
libraries.author: Jhagas Hana Winaya <jhagas@e.email>,Achmad Nashruddin Riskynanda <achmad.riskynanda01@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: A Arduino Platform Library for interfacing ESP32/ESP8266 to Supabase, including user authentication.
libraries.paragraph: This allows developers to interface their ESP32/ESP8266 with Supabase, an open-source alternative to Firebase. The library simplifies the process of connecting to Supabase by providing a set of functions that abstract away the complexity of the underlying API.

libraries.name: ESPToon
libraries.author: Chinmay Nagar <chinmay@chipnexa.in>
libraries.sentence: Typed Object Oriented Notation (TOON) for embedded systems
libraries.paragraph: Lightweight, typed, hierarchical data notation optimized for MCU-class systems. Features low memory usage, deterministic behavior, offline-first operation, and binary-safe persistent storage with CRC validation. Fully compatible with Arduino IDE, PlatformIO, and Arduino CLI. Supports ESP32 (all variants) and ESP8266.

libraries.name: EspTunnel
libraries.author: device-tunnel.top
libraries.sentence: WebSocket tunnel to your device
libraries.paragraph: Create public http/s tunnels to your device.

libraries.name: ESPUI
libraries.author: Lukas Bachschwell
libraries.sentence: ESP32 and ESP8266 Web Interface Library
libraries.paragraph: A simple library that implements a web graphical user interface for ESP32 and ESP8266. It is simple to use and works side by side with your sketch.

libraries.name: EspUsbDevice
libraries.author: TANAKA Masayuki
libraries.sentence: Simple explicit USB Device library for ESP32 Arduino.
libraries.paragraph: EspUsbDevice provides explicit USB device configuration, HID keyboard/mouse/gamepad/custom/vendor APIs, CDC ACM, USB MIDI, MSC RAM/FAT/SD helpers, vendor-specific bulk/control APIs, a CDC-NCM network device with optional lwIP/DHCP, USB Audio, and multi-function composite devices for ESP32 Arduino sketches.

libraries.name: EspUsbHost
libraries.author: TANAKA Masayuki
libraries.sentence: This is a library for using USB Host with ESP32.
libraries.paragraph: You can use the functions of the USB host such as the keyboard by using ESP32-S3 etc.

libraries.name: ESPVGAX
libraries.author: Sandro Maffiodo <smaffer@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: VGA signal generator for ESP8266
libraries.paragraph: Supports monocromatic 512x480px with additional dynamic colors

libraries.name: ESPVGAX2
libraries.author: Sandro Maffiodo <smaffer@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: VGA signal generator for ESP8266
libraries.paragraph: Supports 320x240px or 256x240px with 16 colors

libraries.name: ESPWebDAV
libraries.author: ardyesp
libraries.sentence: WebDav server compatible with linux, macOS, windows.
libraries.paragraph: This library allows to share the uC filesystem (SPIFFS, LittleFS or SDFS) through network with native clients (without need for external ones). Virtual files are also possible.

libraries.name: EspWebFileManager
libraries.author: Jobit Joseph
libraries.sentence: A library to manage various file systems and provide file management over web interface for ESP32.
libraries.paragraph: EspWebFileManager simplifies the initialization and management of multiple file systems like SD Card(SPI, 1-bit SD_MMC, 4-bit SD_MMC), SPIFFS, LittleFS, and FATfs on ESP32. It also provides a web interface for file operations.

libraries.name: espwifiarduino
libraries.author: Taras E
libraries.sentence: Library for espwifiarduino board
libraries.paragraph: Library for espwifiarduino board

libraries.name: ESPWiFiManagerByDroidbane
libraries.author: Droidbane
libraries.sentence: ESP8266 server-based operations: remote Wi-Fi get wifi password and ssid from phone or web, reboot and update wifi information.
libraries.paragraph: This ESP8266-based library simplifies remote device management. New Wi-Fi SSID and password information is retrieved via the phone or web interface, stored in the LittleFS file system, and automatically connected to the network when the device is rebooted. Existing settings can be updated or deleted. REST endpoints: /wifi (POST: ssid, password), /restart (POST), /wifi-update (POST). Usage examples can be reviewed in the File → Examples → ESPWiFiManagerByDroidbane menu.

libraries.name: ESPWiFiMqttWrapper
libraries.author: Anwar Minarso
libraries.sentence: ESP8266 and ESP32 WiFi - MQTT Wrapper
libraries.paragraph: This library is a wrapper for WiFi and MQTT that serves to make it easier to use.

libraries.name: EspWii
libraries.author: Kevin Harrington <mad.hephaestus@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: A library to send Wii extension controllers data over wifi.
libraries.paragraph: This Arduino library supports mapping Wii devices to the Wifi of an ESP32.

libraries.name: espx
libraries.author: Simone Salerno <info@salernosimone.com>
libraries.sentence: A collection of utilities for the ESP32
libraries.paragraph: Follow the project at salernosimone.com for details

libraries.name: ESPxRGB
libraries.author: technosf <github.10.technomation@xoxy.net>
libraries.sentence: RGB manipulation functions in Xtensa assembler for ESP SoCs
libraries.paragraph: Fast RGB, RGBW, HSV conversion functions and gamma and chromiance correction in raw Xtensa assembler.

libraries.name: ESteme
libraries.author: steme
libraries.sentence: Use ESteme equipment with your Arduino.
libraries.paragraph: This library depends on hardware devices for STEMe.

libraries.name: EtherCard
libraries.author: Jean-Claude Wippler
libraries.sentence: EtherCard is an IPv4 driver for the ENC28J60 chip.

libraries.name: Etherkit JTEncode
libraries.author: Jason Milldrum <milldrum@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: Generate JT65, JT9, JT4, FT8, WSPR, and FSQ symbols on your Arduino.
libraries.paragraph: This library very simply generates a set of channel symbols for JT65, JT9, JT4, FT8, or WSPR based on the user providing a properly formatted Type 6 message for JT65, JT9, or JT4 (which is 13 valid characters), Type 0.0 or 0.5 message for FT8 (v2.0.0 protocol) or a callsign, Maidenhead grid locator, and power output for WSPR. It will also generate an arbitrary FSQ message of up to 200 characters in both directed and non-directed format. When paired with a synthesizer that can output frequencies in fine, phase-continuous tuning steps (such as the Si5351), then a beacon or telemetry transmitter can be created which can change the transmitted characters as needed from the Arduino.

libraries.name: Etherkit Morse
libraries.author: Jason Milldrum <milldrum@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: Generate Morse Code for transmission on an digital I/O pin.
libraries.paragraph: Provide this library with a function that calls every one millisecond, and it will generate Morse code for you on the digital pin and at the sending speed that you desire.

libraries.name: Etherkit Si5351
libraries.author: Jason Milldrum <milldrum@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: A full-featured library for the Si5351 series of clock generator ICs from Silicon Labs
libraries.paragraph: This library will allow you to control nearly all features of the Si5351, without depending on the proprietary ClockBuilder software from Silicon Labs.

libraries.name: Ethernet
libraries.author: Various (see AUTHORS file for details)
libraries.sentence: Enables network connection (local and Internet) using the Arduino Ethernet Board or Shield.
libraries.paragraph: With this library you can use the Arduino Ethernet (shield or board) to connect to Internet. The library provides both client and server functionalities. The library permits you to connect to a local network also with DHCP and to resolve DNS.

libraries.name: Ethernet_Generic
libraries.author: Various (see AUTHORS file for details)
libraries.sentence: Simple Ethernet library for AVR, AVR Dx, Portenta_H7, Teensy, SAM DUE, SAMD21, SAMD51, STM32F/L/H/G/WB/MP1, nRF52 and RASPBERRY_PI_PICO boards using Ethernet shields W5100, W5200, W5500, W5100S, W6100
libraries.paragraph: With this library, you can use the Arduino Ethernet (shield or board) to connect to Internet. The library provides both Client and server functionalities. The library permits you to connect to a local network also with DHCP and to resolve DNS. The h-only library now  supporting SPI1/SPI2, EthernetLarge, Ethernet2 and Ethernet3 features by simply changing definitions in the sketch. RASPBERRY_PI_PICO using arduino-pico core now can use SPI1. Now STM32, Arduino_mbed boards can use any custom hardware / software SPI and with fix of severe limitation to permit sending much larger data than total 2/4/8/16K buffer

libraries.name: Ethernet_Manager
libraries.author: Khoi Hoang
libraries.sentence: Simple Ethernet Manager for Teensy, SAM DUE, SAMD, nRF52, ESP32 (including ESP32-S2/C3), ESP8266, RP2040-based Nano_RP2040_Connect, RASPBERRY_PI_PICO, etc. boards. Config data saved in ESP LittleFS, SPIFFS or EEPROM, nRF52 LittleFS, EEPROM, DueFlashStorage or SAMD FlashStorage.
libraries.paragraph: Library for configuring/auto(re)connecting Ethernet W5100/W5200/W5500, ENC28J60 and Teensy 4.1 NativeEthernet/QNEthernet at runtime. Use much less memory compared to full-fledge WiFiManager. Config Portal will be auto-adjusted to match the number of dynamic custom parameters. Optional default Credentials to be autoloaded into Config Portal to use or change instead of manually input. Credentials are saved in LittleFS/InternalFS, (emulated-)EEPROM, FlashStorage_SAMD or DueFlashStorage. New powerful-yet-simple-to-use feature to enable adding dynamic custom parameters from sketch and input using the same Config Portal. DoubleDetectDetector as well as Virtual Switches feature permits entering Config Portal as requested. Configurable Customs HTML Headers, including Customs Style, Customs Head Elements, CORS Header.

libraries.name: Ethernet_Manager_Portenta_H7
libraries.author: Khoi Hoang
libraries.sentence: Simple Ethernet Manager for Portenta_H7 board using Ethernet from Portenta Vision shield. Config data saved in LittleFS.
libraries.paragraph: Library for configuring/auto(re)connecting Ethernet at runtime. Use much less memory compared to full-fledge WiFiManager. Config Portal (CP) will be auto-adjusted to match the number of dynamic custom parameters. Optional default Credentials to be autoloaded into CP to use or change instead of manually input. Credentials are saved in LittleFS. New powerful-yet-simple-to-use feature to enable adding dynamic parameters from sketch and input using the same CP. DoubleDetectDetector as well as Virtual Switches feature permits entering CP as requested. Configurable HTML Headers, Customs Style, Head Elements, CORS Header.

libraries.name: Ethernet_Manager_STM32
libraries.author: Khoi Hoang
libraries.sentence: Simple Ethernet Manager for STM32F/L/H/G/WB/MP1 boards with Ethernet LAN8720, W5x00, ENC28J60 or built-in LAN8742A shields, with or without SSL, configuration data saved in EEPROM. With DoubleResetDetect feature.
libraries.paragraph: Library for configuring/auto(re)connecting Ethernet LAN8720, W5x00, ENC28J60 or built-in LAN8742A at runtime. Use much less memory compared to full-fledge WiFiManager. Config Portal (CP) will be auto-adjusted to match the number of dynamic custom parameters. Optional default Credentials to be autoloaded into CP to use or change instead of manually input. Credentials and Configuration Data are saved in emulated-EEPROM using FlashStorage_STM32. New powerful-yet-simple-to-use feature to enable adding dynamic custom parameters from sketch and input using the same CP. DoubleDetectDetector as well as Virtual Switches feature permits entering CP as requested. Configurable Customs HTML Headers, including Customs Style, Customs Head Elements, CORS Header. Ethernet_Generic library is used as default for W5x00

libraries.name: Ethernet_Shield_W5200
libraries.author: Seeed Studio
libraries.sentence: Arduino library to control Ethernet Shield W5200.
libraries.paragraph: Arduino library to control Ethernet Shield W5200.

libraries.name: Ethernet2
libraries.author: Various
libraries.sentence: Enables network connection (local and Internet) using W5500 based Ethernet shields.
libraries.paragraph: With this library you can use W5500 based Ethernet shields, such as the 'Arduino Ethernet Shield v2' to connect to Internet, but not older W5100 based shields. The library provides both Client and server functionalities. The library permits you to connect to a local network also with DHCP and to resolve DNS.

libraries.name: Ethernet3
libraries.author: Arduino/sstaub
libraries.sentence: Enables network connection (local and Internet) using the Arduino Ethernet board or shield. For all Arduino boards.
libraries.paragraph: With this library you can use the Arduino Ethernet (shield or board) to connect to Internet. The library provides both Client and server functionalities. The library permits you to connect to a local network also with DHCP and to resolve DNS.

libraries.name: EthernetBonjour
libraries.author: Georg Kaindl <info@gkaindl.com>
libraries.sentence: Bonjour (ZeroConf) Library for Arduino & Teensyduino
libraries.paragraph: mDNS (registering services) and DNS-SD (service discovery) has been tested and works on: Teensy++2 with WIZ81MJ, Teensy3 with WIZ820io and Arduino with Ethernet shield

libraries.name: EthernetENC
libraries.author: Norbert Truchsess, Juraj Andrassy
libraries.sentence: Ethernet library for ENC28J60. Only include EthernetENC.h instead of Ethernet.h
libraries.paragraph: This is a modern version of the UIPEthernet library. EthernetENC library is compatible with all Arduino architectures with Arduino SPI library with transactions support.

libraries.name: EthernetESP32
libraries.author: Juraj Andrassy
libraries.sentence: Alternative Ethernet library for the ESP32 platform.
libraries.paragraph: EthernetESP32 is an alternative to the ESP32 platform bundled ETH library. It has the legacy Arduino Ethernet API and adds support for ENC28J60.

libraries.name: EthernetEspAT
libraries.author: Juraj Andrassy
libraries.sentence: Enables wired (secure) network connection with esp8266 or esp32 as network adapter on Serial interface.
libraries.paragraph: This library creates standard Arduino Ethernet networking API over ESP AT commands. It works with WiFiEspAT library and enables to use WiFi and Ethernet in one sketch. Especially for AVR based boards it allows to use secure layer comunication over wired network. The library requires AT firmware built with Ethernet support.

libraries.name: EthernetIndustruino
libraries.author: Industruino and others
libraries.sentence: Library for the Industruino Ethernet module
libraries.paragraph: With this library you can use the Industruino Ethernet module to communicate over Ethernet and to connect to Internet. The library provides both client and server functionalities, allows to connect to a local network (also with DHCP) and to resolve DNS.

libraries.name: EthernetSP
libraries.author: crane-elec based on Various
libraries.sentence: Enables network connection using the W5500-Ether add-on for Spresense.
libraries.paragraph: This library is a modified version of the standard Arduino Ethernet library, specifically adapted for the "W5500-Ether" add-on board for Spresense. https://crane-elec.co.jp/products/vol-20/

libraries.name: EthernetWebServer
libraries.author: Khoi Hoang
libraries.sentence: Simple Ethernet WebServer, HTTP Client and WebSocket Client library for AVR, AVR Dx, Portenta_H7, Teensy, SAM DUE, SAMD21, SAMD51, STM32F/L/H/G/WB/MP1, nRF52 and RASPBERRY_PI_PICO boards using Ethernet shields W5100, W5200, W5500, W6100, ENC28J60 or Teensy 4.1 NativeEthernet/QNEthernet
libraries.paragraph: The WebServer supports HTTP GET and POST requests, provides argument parsing, handles one client at a time. It now provides HTTP Client and WebSocket Client. It supports Arduino boards (Atmel AVR-s, AVR-Dx, SAM DUE, Atmel SAM3X8E ARM Cortex-M3, SAMD21, SAMD51, ESP8266, ESP32, Adafruit nRF52, Teensy boards, Realtek Ameba(RTL8195A,RTL8710)) using Wiznet W5x00/W6100 or ENC28J60 network shields. It now supports WebServer serving from LittleFS/SPIFFS for ESP8266/ESP32. Ethernet_Generic library is used as default for W5x00 with custom SPI.

libraries.name: EthernetWebServer_SSL
libraries.author: Khoi Hoang
libraries.sentence: Simple TLS/SSL Ethernet WebServer, HTTP Client and WebSocket Client library for for AVR, Portenta_H7, Teensy, SAM DUE, SAMD21, SAMD51, STM32F/L/H/G/WB/MP1, nRF52 and RASPBERRY_PI_PICO boards using Ethernet shields W5100, W5200, W5500, ENC28J60 or Teensy 4.1 NativeEthernet/QNEthernet. It now supports Ethernet TLS/SSL Client.
libraries.paragraph: The WebServer supports HTTP/HTTPS GET and POST requests, provides argument parsing, handles one client at a time. It now provides HTTP Client and WebSocket Client. It supports Arduino boards (SAM DUE, Atmel SAM3X8E ARM Cortex-M3, SAMD21, SAMD51, ESP8266, ESP32, Adafruit nRF52, Teensy and RASPBERRY_PI_PICO boards) using Wiznet W5x00, ENC28J60 network shields or Teensy 4.1 built-in NativeEthernet/QNEthernet. Ethernet_Generic library is used as default for W5x00 with custom SPI

libraries.name: EthernetWebServer_SSL_STM32
libraries.author: Khoi Hoang
libraries.sentence: Simple TLS/SSL Ethernet WebServer, HTTP Client and WebSocket Client library for STM32F/L/H/G/WB/MP1 boards running WebServer using built-in Ethernet LAN8742A, Ethernet LAN8720, W5x00 or ENC28J60 shields. It now supports Ethernet TLS/SSL Client.
libraries.paragraph: The WebServer supports HTTP/HTTPS GET and POST requests, provides argument parsing, handles one client at a time. It now provides HTTP(S) Client and Secured WebSockets Client. It supports Arduino STM32F/L/H/G/WB/MP1 series with 32+ Kbytes of Flash, using built-in LAN8742A Ethernet (Nucleo-144: F429ZI, F767ZI, Discovery: STM32F746G-DISCOVERY), or LAN8720, ENC28J60, W5x00 Ethernet shields. Ethernet_Generic library is used as default for W5x00. Now W5x00 can use any custom hardware / software SPI

libraries.name: EthernetWebServer_STM32
libraries.author: Khoi Hoang
libraries.sentence: EthernetWebServer_STM32 is a simple Ethernet WebServer, HTTP Client and WebSocket Client library for STM32F/L/H/G/WB/MP1 boards using built-in Ethernet LAN8742A, LAN8720, Ethernet W5x00 or ENC28J60 shields
libraries.paragraph: The library supports HTTP GET and POST requests, provides argument parsing, handles one client at a time. It now provides HTTP Client and WebSocket Client. It supports Arduino STM32F/L/H/G/WB/MP1 series with 32+ Kbytes of Flash, using built-in Ethernet (Nucleo-144: F429ZI, F767ZI, Discovery: STM32F746G-DISCOVERY), or LAN8720, ENC28J60, W5x00 Ethernet shields. Ethernet_Generic library is used as default for W5x00. Now W5x00 can use any custom hardware / software SPI

libraries.name: EtherSia
libraries.author: Nicholas Humfrey <njh@aelius.com>
libraries.sentence: IPv6 library for the ENC28J60, W5500 or W5100 Ethernet controllers
libraries.paragraph: A library to allow network communication using IPv6 over Ethernet. Supports a minimal HTTP Server, UDP Client and Server, DNS lookup and SLAAC (Stateless Auto-configuration).

libraries.name: ETL_Arduino
libraries.author: Meer Zafarullah Noohani <https://github.com/meerzafarnoohani>
libraries.sentence: Embedded Template Library (ETL). Fixed size containers and state machines for Arduino and ESP32 with zero heap allocation.
libraries.paragraph: ETL_Arduino provides production-grade, no-heap C++ containers for embedded systems: fixed-size vector, queue (circular buffer), map (key-value store), string, and a finite state machine with enter/exit/update callbacks. Designed as a safe replacement for STL on Arduino and ESP32 where heap fragmentation is a concern. All storage is compile-time allocated, no malloc, no new, no fragmentation.

libraries.name: ev3-arduino
libraries.author: Gkagkas Anastasios <tasosggps@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: Enables the communication with an ev3 brick
libraries.paragraph: Only mailbox is implemented in this version.  More functionalities will be implemented in the future.

libraries.name: ev3lego
libraries.author: Gal Arbel gal.arbel8@gmail.com
libraries.sentence: PID controlled motor
libraries.paragraph: ev3 motor hacked!

libraries.name: eva-core-sk
libraries.author: Andrey Gusev
libraries.sentence: EVA Core | EVA survival kit. Architectural core with essential components for event-driven Arduino applications
libraries.paragraph: Eva-core-sk is organized into two distinct layers: Core of the engine: Tickable, Handler, IReader. These are the fundamental building blocks that make the concept work. Survival Kit (SK) - ready-to-use components: Button, Switch, Timer, Indicator, and more. These are what you reach for when building actual applications.

libraries.name: eva-motors
libraries.author: Andrey Gusev
libraries.sentence: EVA Motors. A modular C++ library for motor and actuator control on Arduino.
libraries.paragraph: EVA Motors is a decorator-based library for behavioral modification of micro-motors. EVA Motors lets you compose behavior by stacking decorators that add specific characteristics like S-curve response, inertia simulation, or kick-start pulses

libraries.name: EventAnalog
libraries.author: Philip Fletcher <philip.fletcher@stutchbury.com>
libraries.sentence: Event based library for analog inputs.
libraries.paragraph: Slice an analog range into configurable increments and a callback will be fired on each change of increment. Effective noise reduction built in. Also has an idle timeout callback.

libraries.name: EventBasedFramework
libraries.author: 4Project
libraries.sentence: EBF - Event Based Framework for Arduino
libraries.paragraph: EBF adds easy C++ abstraction layers allowing to program based on the events in the system, creating a code close to the real world programmig, using timers, interrupts, message queues and other techniques found in embedded environments.

libraries.name: EventButton
libraries.author: Philip Fletcher <philip.fletcher@stutchbury.com>
libraries.sentence: Event based button library
libraries.paragraph: A comprehensive event library for efficient, maintainable working with buttons. Multi-click events (1-n). Long press repeat. Many other events can be handled.

libraries.name: EventEmitter
libraries.author: RyLee Harrison <ryleeharrison@icloud.com>
libraries.sentence: Lightweight Node.js-style EventEmitter for Arduino.
libraries.paragraph: EventEmitter for Arduino brings a familiar Node.js event model to embedded systems. It is designed for memory efficiency and speed using fixed-size buffers and statically allocated arrays.

libraries.name: EventEthernet

libraries.paragraph: This library provides an event driven approach for receiving Ethernet data/status, rather than the traditional polling method.

libraries.name: Eventfun
libraries.author: Eugene Pistrak
libraries.sentence: Basic building blocks for event-driven Arduino sketches.
libraries.paragraph: Easily manage events and reactions in your projects. Perfect structural or object-oriented programming.

libraries.name: EventJoystick
libraries.author: Philip Fletcher <philip.fletcher@stutchbury.com>
libraries.sentence: Event based library for analog joysticks.
libraries.paragraph: Slice each axis of the joysick into configurable increments and a callback will be fired on each change of increment. Effective noise reduction built in. Also has an idle timeout callback.

libraries.name: EventOS
libraries.author: Natan Lisowski <pythonboardsbeta@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for event-driven embedded devices programming (hardware interruputs for all pins).
libraries.paragraph: A lot of automation done for you, events for every pin (RISING , FALLING, CHANGE) implemented in software. add event listener using AddEventListener(...) function

libraries.name: EventSource
libraries.author: Romain Brestac
libraries.sentence: Server-Sent Events (SSE) client for ESP8266.

libraries.name: EventStateMachine
libraries.author: Corrado Casoni
libraries.sentence: Cross-platform event-driven State Machine for Arduino
libraries.paragraph: A flexible and powerful state machine library with support for multiple callbacks, timeout events, and global state transition handlers. Works on ESP8266, ESP32, AVR, and RP2040.

libraries.name: EventSystem
libraries.author: Natan Lisowski
libraries.sentence: Event based system that monitor variables and fire event when the variable change.
libraries.paragraph: Subscribe variable and whenever value changes fire an event

libraries.name: Eventually
libraries.author: Jonathan Bartlett <jonathan@bartlettpublishing.com>
libraries.sentence: Event-based programming library for Arduino
libraries.paragraph: This library is meant to make Arduino programming tasks much more simplified by using an event-driven model rather than the standard looping model.

libraries.name: Eventually2
libraries.author: Jonathan Bartlett <jonathan@bartlettpublishing.com>
libraries.sentence: Event-based programming library for Arduino
libraries.paragraph: This library is meant to make Arduino programming tasks much more simplified by using an event-driven model rather than the standard looping model.

libraries.sentence: TC3, TC4 or TC5 timer library for SAMD21 microcontrollers.
libraries.paragraph: This library allows using the TC3_Handler, TC4_Handler and the TC5_Handler routine triggered by the 16-bit Timer/Counter TC3, TC4 or TC5 on SAMD21 (e. g. Arduino MKRZERO). It is also possible to use TC4 and TC5 as a 32-bit Timer/Counter. It is possible to trigger very fast (a few microseconds, e. g. 4 us and less, depending on the runtime of the handler routine/function). You can use fraction numbers as interval (e. g. 2.5 us). Keep in mind, TC4 and TC5 are not completely independent. But you can use TC4 and TC5 together as a 32-bit counter. This 32-bit counter allows to call the interrupt with a time between calls up to 1 day and more.
