libraries.paragraph: This library provides easy methods to use to communicate between two arduino's. This library can send booleans, integers, floats and text over serial communication.

libraries.name: SerialVariable
libraries.author: Jan Fischer <JanTheFischer@gmail.com>, Taylor Hearn <HearnTaylor@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: Save values to the Arduino over Serial
libraries.paragraph: Makes Integer, Double, Float, Bool, and Char arrays that can be saved to by sending an index number and a value over the serial port.  Allows for simple saving and callback saving such that every time a new variable is saved it can be immediatly used.

libraries.name: SerialWeb
libraries.author: 00kenno <irongolem0100@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: Enables monitor any string on captive portal.
libraries.paragraph: Arduino library for monitor any string on captive portal. Works with Raspberry Pico W, Pico 2W and ESP32.

libraries.name: SerialWireOutput
libraries.author: Koen De Vleeschauwer
libraries.sentence: With Serial Wire Output (SWO) an stm32duino can write tracing and logging to a pc at high speed.
libraries.paragraph: To use this library, you need a debugger probe to connect your arduino to your pc. Serial Wire Output only works on systems with arm processors, sorry.

libraries.name: SerialWombat
libraries.author: Broadwell Consulting Inc <help@serialwombat.com>
libraries.sentence: A library to drive the Serial Wombat Family by UART or I2C.
libraries.paragraph: The Serial Wombat is a Smart I/O Expansion chip for Arduino, Raspberry Pi, CircuitPython, native embedded systems, PC, or any other system that can communicate by UART or I2C.  Learn more at www.SerialWombat.com .  The Serial Wombat is open-source firmware on a microcontroller.  The firmware is available at: https://github.com/BroadwellConsultingInc/SerialWombat.  This library syncs with Serial Wombat 4B firmware 2.0.3 and Serial Wombat 18AB firmware 2.2.4, and Serial Wombat 8B firmware 2.2.4

libraries.name: SerialWombat18ABVGADriver
libraries.author: Broadwell Consulting Inc <help@serialwombat.com>
libraries.sentence: A library to Connect the Serial Wombat 18AB VGA Pin mode to Adafruit GFX
libraries.paragraph: The Serial Wombat 18AB chip is capable of driving a VGA display at 160 x 120 pixels.  This library connects the Adafruit GFX drawing library to the Interfaces provided by the Serial Wombat 18AB chip's VGA pin mode.

libraries.name: Serie
libraries.author: Philippe Thomy <philippe.thomy@renault.com>
libraries.sentence: A library for mesures that makes easy to use time series

libraries.name: Servo
libraries.author: Michael Margolis, Arduino
libraries.sentence: Allows Arduino boards to control a variety of servo motors.
libraries.paragraph:
This library can control a great number of servos.
It makes careful use of timers: the library can control 12 servos using only 1 timer.
On the Arduino Due you can control up to 60 servos.

libraries.name: Servo Hardware PWM
libraries.author: Daniel Duller <daniel.duller@gmx.net>
libraries.sentence: Allows Arduino/Genuino Mega boards to control up to 9 servos with the integrated 16-bit hardware PWM timer/counter.
libraries.paragraph:
This library uses the 16-bit hardware timer/counter (timer3, timer4 and timer5) to control the servos.
Possible output pins are pin 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 44, 45 and 46.
Unlike the original Servo.h library, this library does not use Timer1.
The advantage here is that when using the Wire.h library no fluctuations in the pulse width occur.
In addition, I / O registers are addressed directly and not via the digitalWrite()-function (as in Servo.h).

libraries.name: Servo_Motor_Module

libraries.name: ServoESP32

libraries.paragraph:
ServoHack provides precise servo control with potentiometer feedback, fail-safe operation, and EEPROM-based calibration.
It supports speed-controlled movements, position verification, and mechanical obstruction detection.
Ideal for robotics, automation, and testing rigs where reliable servo positioning is critical.

libraries.name: ServoInput

The library takes care of keeping the shift register output pins updated transparently to the user by implementing an API analog to the Arduino digitalRead() and digitalWrite() functions (and adding a digitalToggle()-kind method as present in other platforms). In addition the API extends the Arduino API by adding methods to manipulate one or several pins outputs simultaneously: set or reset all the pins in a single call, set or reset pins through a bitmask, etc. The library also provides a mechanism to create 'virtual ports' that can handle a subset of contiguous pins, allowing the user to treat them as a single entity, for 1 to 16 pins long segments. Contains a large library of crop data to select from that will automatically aim the system for the best growing parameters during the various growth phases for the system configured, along with fully customizable weekly feed/additive amounts and daily feeding/lighting scheduling. With the right setup Hydruino can automatically do things like: enable grow lights for the needed period each day, drive water pumps and auto-dosers during feedings, spray leafy plants in the morning before lights/sunrise, heat cold water to a specific temp for tropical plants, use CO2 sensors to manage air circulation fans to maintain optimal grow tent parameters, or even use soil moisture sensing to dynamically determine watering schedule.

Works with a large variety of widely-available aquarium/hobbyist equipment, including popular GPS, RTC, EEPROM, SD card, WiFi, and other modules compatible with Arduino. Can be setup to calculate sun position accurately as possible or to auto-balance two opposing photoresistors per panel axis. With the right setup Helioduino can automatically do things like: drive large panels with linear actuators, use power sensing to auto-optimize daily panel offset, spray/wipe panels on routine to keep panels clean, deploy/retract panels at sunrise/sunset, or even provide panel heating during cold temperatures or when ice is detected.

Issues or questions: https://github.com/bhagman/SmartDial/issues

libraries.name: SmartEverything CC2541
libraries.author: development
libraries.sentence: Library code for the TDK-SP13808 module.
libraries.paragraph: The TDK-SP13808 module incapsulates the Texas Instruments CC2541, a BLE devicecommunicating with the SmartEverything though standard UART.

libraries.name: SmartEverything HTS221
libraries.author: Seve
libraries.sentence: Library code for HTS221 Capacitive digital sensor for relative humidity and temperature
libraries.paragraph:
The HTS221 is an ultra compact sensor for relative humidity and temperature.
It includes a sensing element and a mixed signal ASIC to provide the measurement information through digital serial interfaces.
The sensing element consists of a polymer dielectric planar capacitor structure capable of detecting relative humidity variations and is manufactured using a dedicated ST process.
The HTS221 is available in a small top-holed cap land grid array (HLGA) package guaranteed to operate over a temperature range from -40 °C to +120 °C.

libraries.name: SmartEverything Lion RN2483
libraries.author: development
libraries.sentence: Library code for the Microchip RN2483 LoaraWAN Module
libraries.paragraph: The RN2483 module provides LoRaWAN protocol connectivity using a simple UART interface.

libraries.name: SmartEverything LPS25H
libraries.author: Seve
libraries.sentence: Library code for LPS25H MEMS pressure sensor: 260-1260 hPa absolute digital output barometer
libraries.paragraph:
The LPS25H is an ultra compact absolute piezoresistive pressure sensor.
It includes a monolithic sensing element and an IC interface able to take the information from the sensing element and to provide a digital signal to the external world.

The sensing element consists of a suspended membrane realized inside a single mono-silicon substrate.
It is capable to detect the absolute pressure and is manufactured with a dedicated process developed by ST.

libraries.name: SmartEverything LSM6DS3
libraries.author: Zero-2
libraries.sentence: Library code for LSM6DS3 iNEMO inertial module:3D accelerometer, 3D gyroscope
libraries.paragraph:
The LSM6DS3 is a system-in-package featuring a 3D digital linear acceleration sensor, a 3D digital angular rate sensor.
The LSM6DS3 has a linear acceleration full scale of ±2g/±4g/±8/±16 g, a magnetic field full scale of ±4/±8/±12/±16 gauss and an angular rate of ±245/±500/±2000 dps.
The LSM6DS3 includes an I2C serial bus interface supporting standard and fast mode (100 kHz and 400 kHz) and an SPI serial standard interface.
Accelerometer and gyroscope sensing can be enabled or set in power-down mode separately for smart power management.

libraries.name: SmartEverything LSM9DS1
libraries.author: Seve
libraries.sentence: Library code for LSM9DS1 iNEMO inertial module:3D accelerometer, 3D gyroscope, 3D magnetometer
libraries.paragraph:
The LSM9DS1 is a system-in-package featuring a 3D digital linear acceleration sensor, a 3D digital angular rate sensor, and a 3D digital magnetic sensor.
The LSM9DS1 has a linear acceleration full scale of ±2g/±4g/±8/±16 g, a magnetic field full scale of ±4/±8/±12/±16 gauss and an angular rate of ±245/±500/±2000 dps.
The LSM9DS1 includes an I2C serial bus interface supporting standard and fast mode (100 kHz and 400 kHz) and an SPI serial standard interface.
Magnetic, accelerometer and gyroscope sensing can be enabled or set in power-down mode separately for smart power management.

libraries.name: SmartEverything NFC NT3H1101
libraries.author: Mik
libraries.sentence: Library code for the NXP NT3H1101 a NFC_I2C module
libraries.paragraph:
The NXP NT3H1101 is the first product of NXP's NTAG family offering both contactless and contact interfaces.
In addition to the passive NFC Forum compliant contactless interface, the IC features an I2C contact interface, which can communicate with a microcontroller if the NTAG I2C is powered from an external power supply.

libraries.name: SmartEverything SE868-AS
libraries.author: Seve
libraries.sentence: Library code for the Telit SE868-AS GPS System
libraries.paragraph:
The SE868-AS is a GPS Smart antenna module featuring an embedded antenna with an optimized RF path and standard SMT mounting.
The SE868-AS is designed to track and navigate GPS and QZSS constellations, giving the positioning data though standard UART at a very low power rate.

libraries.name: SmartEverything SIGFOX LE51-868
libraries.author: Mik
libraries.sentence: Library code for the TELEIT LE51-868 a SIGFOX module
libraries.paragraph:
The LE51-868 S is a high performance certified Short Range to Long Range module designed to cover the 863-870 MHz band working with the Telit Proprietary protocol and acting as a SIGFOX gateway.
It has high value technical characteristics such as a -126dBm sensitivity, ultra-low power consumption and up to 15.5dBm of Output power.
It is very easy to integrate, with small form factor and acts as a long range communication module connecting directly to SIGFOX network

libraries.name: SmartEverything VL6180X

libraries.sentence: Library code for the Ambient Light & Proximity sensor from ST component.
libraries.paragraph:
Combining an IR emitter, a range sensor and an ambient light sensor in a three-in-one ready-to-use reflowable package.
The VL6180X is easy to integrate and saves the end-product maker long and costly optical and mechanical design optimizations.

libraries.paragraph: SmartPins allows you to easily and implcitly read from pins and write to pins using intuitive grammar. Reading from a SmartPin variable (or assigning it to another variable) implicitly reads the pin state. Writing to a SmartPin variable implicitly writes to the pin. Simple button following LED examples can be as simple as `led = button;`.

libraries.paragraph: SmartProv enables any ESP32 or ESP8266 device to be configured over a mobile-friendly captive portal — no companion app required. Features include multi-network fallback, dynamic custom form fields, persistent flash storage (NVS on ESP32, EEPROM on ESP8266), factory reset via hardware button, LED status indication, and a clean state-machine architecture. A modern alternative to WiFiManager.

The AS726X Breakout is unique in its ability to communicate by both an I2C interface and serial interface using AT commands. Hookup is easy, thanks to the Qwiic connectors attached to the board --- simply plug one end of the Qwiic cable into the breakout and the other into one of the Qwiic Shields, then stack the board on a development board. You’ll be ready to upload a sketch to start taking spectroscopy measurements in no time.

The Bio Sensor Hub is a practically microscopic cortex-m0 micro-controller that handles the algorithmic calculation of  the light data gathered by the MAX30101 Pulse Oximeter and Heart Rate Monitor, to produce accurate and fast blood oxygen and heart rate readings. The library provides simple function calls to all available commands on the chip as well as example code demonstrating  basic to advanced capabilities of the chip.

libraries.name: SparkFun BMV080 Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: The SparkFun Air Quality PM1/PM2.5/PM10 Sensor - BMV080 (Qwiic)is an ultra-small, fan-less air quality sensor for sensing particulate matter!
libraries.paragraph: NOTE: This library requires the installation of the Bosch BMV080 SDK - See https://github.com/sparkfun/SparkFun_BMV080_Arduino_Library for instructions. The sensing element measures merely 4.2mm x 3.5mm x 3.1mm (W x L x H), which is more than 450 times smaller than any comparable device on the market. The innovative design is based on ultra-compact lasers with integrated photodiodes. The sensor applies sophisticated algorithms to measure PM1 and PM2.5 concentrations directly in free space, without requiring an intrusive fan.

It's what we've been waiting for: all the sensor data is combined into meaningful, accurate IMU information. Available at: https://www.sparkfun.com/products/14586

libraries.name: SparkFun Clock 5P49V60 Arduino Library

libraries.paragraph: The SparkFun Clock Generator 5P49V60 breakout board offers a wide range of customizable frequencies in a wide range of different signal types using a single reference clock. Four (single output) clock outputs can generate frequencies from 1MHz-200MHz and eight (differential output) clock outputs can generate frequencies from 1MHz-350MHz. The frequency's many properties can be manipulated in code via I2C using the SparkFun Arduino Library. The SparkFun Clock Generator also has four banks of programmable memory for the time when it's ready to sit on its' own within the project without a microcontroller.

libraries.name: SparkFun External EEPROM Arduino Library

libraries.sentence: Library for I2C Communication with external EEPROMs
libraries.paragraph: A library for the advanced control of any I2C based EEPROM. This library writes extremely fast and automatically handles the writing of pages to make the entire EEPROM act as one large writable block. Automatically reads and writes ints, floats, arrays, and structs. Works with all EEPROMs including very large >512kbit EEPROMs and any Wire port (Wire1, etc). Use with Qwiic EEPROM to make it easy to read and write cal data and other user settings. Configurable I2C buffer size increases throughput up to 30kB/s. Includes examples demonstrating wear-level writing, SD file to EEPROM write, and auto writes/verifies to EEPROM. Tested with 24LC00, 24LC01B, 24AA02, 24LC04B, 24LC16BH, 24LC32A, 24LC256, CAT24C512, 24LC1025, and 24LC1026.

libraries.name: SparkFun MAX3010x Pulse and Proximity Sensor Library

libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the MAX3015 particle sensor and MAX30102 Pulse Ox sensor

libraries.name: SparkFun MAX31855K Thermocouple Digitizer

libraries.name: SparkFun MCP4725 Arduino Library

libraries.paragraph: Provides fast mode and standard DAC register writes, DAC+EEPROM writes, and full register reads including power-down mode status. Built on the SparkFun Toolkit bus abstraction for portability across I2C implementations.

libraries.name: SparkFun MCP9600 Thermocouple Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Driver for Microchip's MCP9600 Thermocouple Amplifier.
libraries.paragraph: The MCP9600 is an integrated thermocouple amplifier featuring a typical accuracy of ±0.5°C and a maximum accuracy of ±1.5°C, with support for many thermocouple types, conversion modes, and a configurable exponential moving average filter.

libraries.name: SparkFun MetaWatch
libraries.author: Jim@SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: A simple library to interface from Arduino to BlueSMiRF to MetaWatch
libraries.paragraph: Sets up auto-connection between Arduino and the MetaWatch, and gives user control over the backlight, time settings, and battery level readings.

libraries.name: SparkFun MG2639 CellShield
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Driver library for SparkFun's MG2639 cellular shield.
libraries.paragraph: Simple API to use SMS, TCP, and other functions made available by the MG2639 Cellular Shield.

libraries.name: SparkFun Micro OLED Breakout
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>

libraries.paragraph: The MicroView is a chip-sized Arduino with a built-in OLED, available from SparkFun Electronics.

libraries.name: SparkFun MiniMoto

libraries.paragraph: Communication protocol of I2C, operating voltage of 2.7V to 6.8V and is good for small robotics projects. This library provides basic functionality.

libraries.name: SparkFun MLX90632 Noncontact Infrared Temperature Sensor
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>

libraries.name: SparkFun MMA8452Q Accelerometer

libraries.paragraph: Sensor has user selectable scales of 2g/4g/8g, as well as low power mode, and 12 bit resolution.

libraries.name: SparkFun MMC5983MA Magnetometer Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: A I2C/SPI library for the MMC5983MA magnetic compass sensor.
libraries.paragraph: The Qwiic MMC5983MA Magnetometer is a very sensitive magnetometer capable of sensing down to 0.4mG enabling a heading accuracy of ±0.5°. This is a feature complete library supporting I2C and SPI. Output rates of 1000Hz, ±8G FSR, and 18-bit resolution make the MMC5983MA a phenomenal magnetic sensor.

libraries.name: SparkFun MPL3115A2 Altitude and Pressure Sensor Breakout
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: SparkFun's breakout for the Freescale MPL3115A2 Precision Altimeter
libraries.paragraph: Breakout board for MEMS altitude sensor capable of 30cm altitude resolution.

libraries.name: SparkFun MPU-9250 9 DOF IMU Breakout
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Driver for InvenSense's MPU-9250 9-DOF IMU (3-axis gyroscope, 3-axis accelerometer & 3-axis magnetometer)
libraries.paragraph: The MPU-9250 is a system-in-package featuring acceleration full-scales of ±2 / ±4 / ±8 / ±16 (g), rotational full-scales of ±250 / ±500 / ±1000 / ±2000 (°/sec) and a magnetic field full scale of ±4800 µT. The MPU-9250 includes an I2C serial bus interface that supports speeds up to 400 kHz.

libraries.name: SparkFun MS5637 Barometric Pressure Library
libraries.author: TE Connectivity and SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Library for the SparkFun Qwiic Pressure Sensor - MS5637
libraries.paragraph: The SparkFun breakout board for the MS5637 is a very sensitive, fully calibrated, low power, easy to use barometric pressure sensor capable of detecting a change of as little as 13cm of air! Great for weather sensing and local altimetry projects.

libraries.name: SparkFun MS5803-14BA Pressure Sensor
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>

libraries.paragraph: Provides I2C communication protocol for measuring wather depth, altitude, or other pressure readings.

libraries.name: SparkFun MY1690 MP3 Decoder Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the SparkFun MY1690 MP3 decoder breakout.
libraries.paragraph: The MY1609 MP3 decoder IC is a handy serial based MP3 player. Using a simple commands the MY1609 can pull MP3 files from an SD card and play them over headphones. Additionally, the MY1609 as built-in USB support so the SD card shows up as a jump drive when USB is connected.

libraries.name: SparkFun OWire Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>

libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library for controlling 2-pin Multi-Mode LEDs and Parallel LED strings

libraries.name: SparkFun Particle Sensor Panasonic SN-GCJA5
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: A library to communicate with the Panasonic SN-GCJA5 particle sensor.
libraries.paragraph: Communicates with the SN-GCJA5 over I<sup>2</sup>C to quickly integrate a particle sensor into your project. The sensor detects particulate mass density and particle count for various size particles from PM1.0 to PM10 (0.3-10um). The sensor requires 5V supply and 3.3V I<sup>2</sup>C.

libraries.name: SparkFun PCA9536 Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the PCA9536 on the SparkFun Qwiic RGB Sensor
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the PCA9536 4-bit port expander. This library handles the initialization of the PCA9536 and supports standard pinMode, digitalRead, and digitalWrite functions.

libraries.name: SparkFun PCA9846 Mux Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Library to control I2C multiplexers based on the PCA9846.
libraries.paragraph: I2C multiplexers are useful for connecting multiple I2C devices that have only one address. This library makes it easy to work with the 4-channel PCA9846 I2C multiplexer. This library supports daisychaining multiple muxes so that you can get up to 32 devices on one I2C bus! It also supports generic Wire ports (Wire1, myWire, etc). Checkout the PCA9846 Qwiic Mux for more information.

libraries.name: SparkFun PHT MS8607 Arduino Library

libraries.name: SparkFun PicoDVI

libraries.name: SparkFun ProDriver TC78G670FTG Arduino Library

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Alphanumeric Display Arduino Library

libraries.paragraph: Use our solderless and easy-to-use Qwiic system to send I2C commands to the SparkX Qwiic Alphanumeric Display to print strings. The I2C address is configurable, so you can connect up to four displays on one I2C bus!

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic AS7341L 10-Channel Spectral Sensor
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Configures and communicates with the SparkFun Qwiic AS7341L 10-Channel Spectral Sensor.
libraries.paragraph: This library allows the user to measure light spectrum in 10 different channels: 415nm, 445nm, 480nm, 515nm, 555nm, 590nm, 630nm, 680nm, clear and near infrared. This sensor will measure the color components in a specific target, decomposing light into these individual components.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Button and Qwiic Switch Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Communicates and configures the SparkFun Qwiic Button and Switch.
libraries.paragraph: This library allows the user to see the button status, configure the built-in LED, set up interrupts, change I2C addresses, and interface with the onboard button queues.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Buzzer Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>

libraries.paragraph: This library allows the user to control the buzzer frequency/duration, and change its I2C addresses.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Digital Capacitor Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: A library to get and set the capacitance of the NCD2400M digital capacitor in both volatile and non-volatile memory.
libraries.paragraph: Use our easy-to-use Qwiic system to send I2C commands to the SparkX Qwiic Digital Capacitor to set the capacitance and specify series or shunt configuration. Solder the board onto your system on a 0402 or 0603 footprint and tune the capacitor to your specific application!

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Fan Arduino Library

libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the Qwiic Blower Fan and Qwiic PC Fan Controller. Both allow you to control 4-Wire PC cooling fans over I²C! Available at: https://www.sparkfun.com/products/18570 and https://www.sparkfun.com/products/18561

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic GPIO TCA9534 Arduino Library
libraries.author: Andy England
libraries.sentence: A library to drive the TCA9534 I2C->GPIO
libraries.paragraph: The Qwiic GPIO breaks out 8 extra GPIO on an I2C bus. With 8 configurable addresses, that's 64 extra GPIO on a single I2C Bus.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Haptic Driver DA7280 Library
libraries.author: Elias Santistevan <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the DA7280 Haptic Driver
libraries.paragraph: This library is written for the DA7280 Haptic Driver IC. The DA7280 can run LRA or ERM motors via I2C, PWM, or using onboard memory, it's possible to run it headless.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Humidity AHT20
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics

libraries.paragraph: Use our solderless and easy-to-use Qwiic system to send I2C commands to the SparkX Qwiic Humiditiy AHT20 to get current temperature and humidity readings.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic IR Thermometer MLX90614 Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>

libraries.paragraph: Library for the SparkFun IR Thermometer Evaluation Board, Qwiic IR Thermometer Board, and the MLX90614 IR thermometer.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Joystick Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the SparkFun Qwiic Joystick
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the Qwist Joystick. Qwiic Joystick makes reading an analog joystick over I2C easy and fast. The current joystick position and button state can be read from separate registers. There is also an additional register to check if the button had been pressed since the last read of the button register. Available at: https://www.sparkfun.com/products/15168

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Keypad Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the SparkFun Qwiic Keypad
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the Qwiic Keypad. Qwiic Keypad makes reading a 12 button keypad over I2C easy and fast. The button and the time since it was pressed can be read from separate registers. It actually records up to 15 button presses (and their timestamps) to a stack, which can be read in sequence from oldest to newest. It will overflow and continue to remember the most recent 15 presses. Available at: https://www.sparkfun.com/products/14836

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic LED Stick Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Library for the SparkFun Qwiic LED Stick
libraries.paragraph: The Qwiic LED Stick features ten addressable APA102 LEDs, making it easy to add an output to your latest project. Write to individual LEDs to display a count in binary, or write to the whole strip for cool lighting effects.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic MP3 Trigger Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the SparkFun Qwiic MP3 Trigger
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the Qwist MP3 Trigger. Qwiic MP3 Trigger is an easy to use MP3 player that makes loading and playing MP3s easy and fast. Play, pause, stop, volume, and EQ are all digitally controlled over I2C . Available at: https://www.sparkfun.com/products/15165

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic OLED Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for SparkFun SSD1306 based OLED display products.
libraries.paragraph: A very fast and efficient Arduino library for the SSD1306 driver IC. Transfer rates are up to 400% faster than alternative libraries; only dirty regions of the graphics buffer are sent to the display. Efficient memory usage. No dynamic memory utilized. Static resources are loaded once, and only on explicit declaration. This library supports the SparkFun Qwiic Micro OLED, 0.91in OLED, Transparent Graphical OLED, smôl OLED Display, and any other board using the SSD1306 IC.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic OpenLog
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the SparkFun Qwiic OpenLog
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the SparkFun I2C based datalogger, Qwiic OpenLog. The Qwiic OpenLog is a powerful flexible datalogger that makes it very easy to record any sort of data over I2C which allows for daisychaining and redundant logging. Available at: https://www.sparkfun.com/products/14641

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic OTOS Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: A library to use the SparkFun Qwiic Optical Tracking Odometry Sensor
libraries.paragraph: The SparkFun Qwiic Optical Tracking Odometry Sensor empowers you to elevate a robots navigation capabilities with precision and streamlined integration.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic PIR Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Configures and communicates with the SparkFun Qwiic PIR.
libraries.paragraph: This library allows the user to see if there is currently an object detected in front of the SparkFun PIR (EKMC4607112K/EKMB1107112) as well as allows for reading of detection events from a buffer.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Power Switch Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the Qwiic Power Switch
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino library for the SparkFun Qwiic Power Switch (TI PCA9536)

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Relay Arduino Library
libraries.author: Elias Santistevan
libraries.sentence: Library for the SparkFun Quad, Dual and Single Relay Boards
libraries.paragraph: The SparkFun Qwiic Relay Arduino Library makes it very easy to use the Qwiic enabled relays from SparkFun Electronics. It gives you easy to use functions to turn on and off relays, toggle them, and check their status. Also provided is example code for each board ( and the ) that gives instructions on how to use the library to its fullest.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic RFID Arduino Library
libraries.author: Elias Santistevan
libraries.sentence: Library for the SparkFun Qwiic RFID Reader
libraries.paragraph: The SparkFun Qwiic RFID Arduino Library makes it very easy to use the Qwiic enabled I-squared-C RFID reader from SparkFun Electronics. The SparkFun Qwiic RFID Reader can hold up to 20 scanned RFID tags and their associated scan times at a time. The library gives easy to use functions that allow you to get a scanned tag, get the tag's scan time, or get all 20 available tags and their scan times at once. Also provided is example code to demonstrate each available function.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic RTC RV1805 Arduino Library
libraries.author: Andy England, Nathan Seidle
libraries.sentence: A library to drive the RV-1805 extremely precise, extremely low power, real-time clock
libraries.paragraph: The RV-1805-C3 from SparkFun is a very unique and exciting Real Time Clock. It is extremely precise (less than 7ppm per year!), extremely low power (less than 22nA!) and has all the necessary oscillators built-in making it small! The RV-1805 has not one, but two internal oscillators: a 32.768kHz tuning fork crystal and a lower power RC based oscillator. The RV-1805 can be configured to automatically switch between oscillators using the more precise crystal to correct the RC oscillator every few minutes. This allows the RTC to maintain a very accurate date and time with the worst case being +/- about 3 minutes over a year. The RV-1805 library operates the RTC at 22nA allowing for very long run times with very small backup power sources.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic RTC RV8803 Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: A library to drive the RV-8803 extremely precise, extremely low power, real-time clock
libraries.paragraph: The RV-8803 from SparkFun is an extraordinarily precise, temperature-compensated RTC. The module itself can run as low as 240 nA. This library allows you to set and get time, set the hundredths registers, configure interrupts, and even calibrate your RTC.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Scale NAU7802 Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Library to control the 24-bit load cell amplifier NAU7802.
libraries.paragraph: The Qwiic Scale from SparkFun is based on the NAU7802. This IC is a I2C controlled 24-bit ADC capable of converting load cells into a digital signal. The SparkFun Qwiic Scale board makes it easy to create a digital scale without soldering. Checkout the Qwiic Scale for more information.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Step Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Control one or more stepper motors by sending I2C commands over the easy-to-use Qwiic system to your SparkFun Qwiic Step Board.
libraries.paragraph: Qwiic Step makes stepper motors very easy to control. This library handles all the I2C commands needed to run a motor continuously or to a given position, with constant speed or acceleration, or change microstep modes. We've built-in added features such as reading interrupts, setting up an emergency stop, or running headless for further customizability to your system.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic TMF-8801 Time-of-flight Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Configures and communicates with the SparkFun Qwiic TMF-8801 Time-of-flight sensor.
libraries.paragraph: This library allows the user to measure distances using the TMF-8801 Time-of-flight sensor. TMF-8801 uses infrared laser light, SPAD, TDC and histogram technology to measure distances up to 98.4 inches (2500 mm). This device meets Class 1 laser safety limits including single faults in compliance with IEC / EN 60825-1:2014.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic TMF882X Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the SparkFun Qwiic breakout boards for the AMS TMF882X sensor products.
libraries.paragraph: The TMF882X is the latest Time Of Flight (ToF) sensor to be released from AMS. It uses a SPAD (Single Photon Avalanche Photodiode) histogram architecture to accurately detect objects from 10mm all the way to 5000 mm. That’s millimeter accuracy, with a range of 1 centimeter to 5 meters – amazing! Oh, and these sensors are multi-zone – supporting 3x3, 4x4 and 3x6 zones of operation depending on which model is being used. Available at: https://www.sparkfun.com/products/19036, https://www.sparkfun.com/products/19451

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Twist Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the SparkFun Qwiic Twist Digital Encoder
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the Qwist Twist digital encoder. Qwiic Twist is an RGB encoder that makes creating and control a twist knob easy and fast. The knob can be illuminated any color and a multitude of settings and features are exposed to the end user for customization. Available at: https://www.sparkfun.com/products/15083

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Ultrasonic Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: A library to use the SparkFun Qwiic Ultrasonic Distance Sensor
libraries.paragraph: The SparkFun Qwiic Ultrasonic Distance Sensor, a user-friendly upgrade to the popular HC-SR04 sensor, offers non-contact distance measurement from 2cm to 400cm with an accuracy of 3mm. This sensor is designed to seamlessly integrate with the Qwiic ecosystem for I2C communication, making it a breeze to add to your existing projects and daisy-chain with other Qwiic components.

libraries.name: SparkFun Qwiic Universal Auto-Detect
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: A scalable library for logging data from a wide range of Qwiic sensors
libraries.paragraph:
This library makes it possible to create a scalable Qwiic (I2C) sensing and logging device on a wide range of platforms.

This library is stand-alone and self-contained. It contains a built-in copy of the Arduino Library for each supported sensor. You do not need to worry about installing those libraries yourself.

This library contains everything you need to log data from all supported sensors. You do not need a WiFi connection and it does not need to connect to an IO server or dashboard before you can access your sensor data. No account required!

libraries.name: SparkFun QwiicNES Arduino Library

libraries.sentence: Library for the SparkFun QwiicNES Nintendo Controller Interface
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the QwiicNES Nintendo Controller Interface. The QwiicNES makes it easy to read the buttons on an original NES controller. Available at: https://www.sparkfun.com/products/18038

libraries.name: SparkFun QwiicRF

libraries.name: SparkFun RedBot Library

libraries.paragraph: Includes examples for accelerometer, whisker bumpers, line followers, wheel encoders, and driving control.

libraries.name: SparkFun RFD77402 Distance Sensor - VCSEL Time of Flight
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the SparkFun Qwiic Distance Sensor - RFD77402
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the RFD77402 VCSEL based time of flight distance sensor. Measures up to 2000mm with millimeter precision.

libraries.name: SparkFun RGB OLED 64x64 Library

libraries.paragraph: Library for the RGB OLED 64x64 screen / display. Includes support for the SSD1357 driver IC

libraries.name: SparkFun RHT03 Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: An Arduino library for interfacing with the SparkFun RHT03 (DHT22)
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino library for interfacing with the SparkFun RHT03 (DHT22)

libraries.name: SparkFun SCD30 Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Library for the Sensirion SCD30 CO2 Sensor
libraries.paragraph:
An Arduino library for the SCD30 CO2 sensor from Sensirion. The SCD30 is a high quality NDIR based CO₂ sensor capable of detecting 400 to 10000ppm with an accuracy of ±(30ppm+3%). In order to improve accuracy the SCD30 has temperature and humidity sensing built-in, as well as commands to set the current altitude.

Get the SCD30 here.

libraries.name: SparkFun SCD4x Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Library for the Sensirion SCD4x family of CO2 Sensors (SCD40 and SCD41)
libraries.paragraph:
An Arduino library for the SCD4x family of CO2 sensors from Sensirion. The SCD41 is a high quality photoacoustic CO₂ sensor capable of detecting 400 to 5000ppm with an accuracy of ±(40ppm+5%). On-chip signal compensation is realized with the built-in SHT4x humidity and temperature sensor.

Get the SCD40 here.

libraries.name: SparkFun SDP3x Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Library for the Sensirion SDP3x Differential Pressure Sensors
libraries.paragraph: This library provides full support for Sensirion’s SDP3x series of small differential pressure sensors - including the SDP31 and SDP32

libraries.name: SparkFun Serial Fingerprint Scanners AS-108M and AD-013
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Configures and communicates with the SparkFun Serial Fingerprint Scanners AS-108M and AD-013.
libraries.paragraph: This library allows the user to use the AS-108M or AD-013 connected via serial port. The user can enroll fingerprints, search for any or a specific match as well as deleting fingeprint entries in any location on the 40 memory locations available.

libraries.name: SparkFun SerLCD Arduino Library
libraries.author: Gaston R. Williams and Nathan Seidle
libraries.sentence: Library for I2C, SPI, and Serial Communication with SparkFun SerLCD Displays
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library to allow simple control of 16x2 and 20x4 character SerLCDs from SparkFun. Includes RGB backlight control, display scrolling, cursor movement, and custom characters all over I2C, SPI, or Serial.

libraries.name: SparkFun SGP30 Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Library for the Sensirion SGP30 air quality sensor
libraries.paragraph: The SGP30 is an indoor air quality sensor equipped with an I<sup>2</sup>C interface. It outputs equivalent CO<sub>2</sub> in ppm and Total Volatile Organic Compounds (TVOC) in ppb. The sensor also gives access to its raw measurement values of Ethanol and H<sub>2</sub>.

libraries.name: SparkFun SGP4 Arduino Library
libraries.author: Hopperpop
libraries.sentence: SGP4 model for calculating satellite positions and predicting overpasses.
libraries.paragraph:
This library uses SGP4 to calculate satellite positions and predict overpasses using Two-Line Elements.

This library is a clone of Hopperpop Sgp4-Library. We have cloned it to allow it to be added to the Arduino Library manager.

libraries.name: SparkFun SGP40 Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Library for the Sensirion SGP40 air quality sensor
libraries.paragraph: The SGP40 is an indoor air quality sensor equipped with an I<sup>2</sup>C interface. This library uses Sensirion’s powerful VOC Algorithm to translate the sensor's raw output signal into a VOC Index as a robust measure for indoor air quality.

libraries.name: SparkFun SHTC3 Humidity and Temperature Sensor Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the SHTC3 humidity and temperature sensor by Sensirion
libraries.paragraph: Library for the SHTC3 humidity and temperature sensor by Sensirion. Read values raw or converted to floating point numbers with units. Enable/disable sleep mode while not being used

libraries.name: SparkFun Si7021 Humidity and Temperature Sensor
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for Si7021 Humidity and Temperature Sensor.
libraries.paragraph: Library for Si7021 Humidity and Temperature Sensor. Support for checking the device ID, as well as CRC is included.

libraries.name: SparkFun Simultaneous RFID Tag Reader Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the RFID Modules from ThingMagic
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the RFID modules for reading and writing to Gen2 UHF (860 to 920MHz) RFID tags.

libraries.name: SparkFun SiT5358 DCTCXO Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: An Arduino library for the SiT5358 DCTCXO from SiTime
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino library for the SiT5358 Digitally-Controlled Temperature-Compensated Crystal Oscillator used by the SparkFun GNSSDO

libraries.name: SparkFun SiT5811 OCXO Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: An Arduino library for the SiT5811 OCXO from SiTime
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino library for the SiT5811 Digitally-Controlled Oven-Controlled Crystal Oscillator used by the SparkFun GNSSDO

libraries.name: SparkFun smol Power Board Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: This library facilitates communication with the smôl Power Boards over I<sup>2</sup>C.
libraries.paragraph:
The smôl Power Board AAA and smôl Power Board LiPo are very compact power boards for the smôl family of boards.
This library makes it easy to communicate with the ATtiny on the power board and configure it for power-down.

libraries.name: SparkFun Soil Moisture Sensor
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: An Arduino library for the SparkFun Qwiic Soil Moisture Sensor.
libraries.paragraph: The SparkFun Soil Moisture Sensor is a simple breakout for measuring the moisture in soil and similar materials. The soil moisture sensor is pretty straight forward to use. The two large, exposed pads function as probes for the sensor, together acting as a variable resistor. The more water that is in the soil means the better the conductivity between the pads will be and will result in a lower resistance, and a higher SIG out. This version of the Soil Moisture Sensor includes a Qwiic connector, making it even easier to use this sensor.

libraries.name: SparkFun Spectral Triad AS7265X
libraries.author: Nathan Seidle and Kevin Kuwata
libraries.sentence: An Arduino library for the AS7265x Triple Spectroscopy Sensor Board
libraries.paragraph: The SparkFun Spectral Triad detects 18 discrete channels of light from 372nm (UV) to 966nm (IR) enabling desktop spectroscopy and other fun applications like counterfeit dectection! Checkout the SparkFun Triad Sensor!

libraries.name: SparkFun SPI SerialFlash Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: A low level library for interfacing to serial flash ICs
libraries.paragraph:
An Arduino Library to erase, read from and write to SPI serial flash memory
Not intended to work with serial EEPROMs

libraries.name: SparkFun ST25DV64KC Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the ST25DV64KC NFC/RFID Tag
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino library for the ST25DV64KC NFC/RFID Tag, as used on the SparkFun Qwiic RFID Tag - ST25DV64KC.

libraries.name: SparkFun STC3x Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Library for the Sensirion STC3x family of CO2 Sensors (STC31)
libraries.paragraph:
An Arduino library for the STC3x family of CO2 sensors from Sensirion. The STC31 uses Sensirion’s patented CMOSens® sensor technology to measure CO2 concentrations up to 100%.

Get the STC31 here.

libraries.name: SparkFun STHS34PF80 Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: A library to drive the STMicroelectronics infrared sensor STHS34PF80.
libraries.paragraph: The STHS34PF80 is a low-power, high-sensitivity infrared sensor for presence and motion detection.

libraries.name: SparkFun STP3593LF OCXO Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: An Arduino library for the STP3593LF OCXO from rakon
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino library for the STP3593LF (ROX5242T1N) Digitally-Controlled Double-Oven Crystal Oscillator used by the SparkFun GNSSDO

libraries.name: SparkFun STUSB4500
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: A library for the SparkFun Power Delivery Board - STUSB4500.
libraries.paragraph: The library allows you to modify the settings for the STUSB4500 USB PD sink controller from STMicroelectronics.

libraries.name: SparkFun Swarm Satellite Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the Swarm M138 satellite modem
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino library for the Swarm M138 satellite modem, as used on the SparkX Swarm Serial Breakout.

libraries.name: Sparkfun T5403 Barometric Sensor Library
libraries.author: Casey Kuhns <casey.kuhns@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Arduino Library for interfacing with the T5403 Barometric sensor.
libraries.paragraph: The T5403 by Epcos is a low cost I2C barometric pressure sensor. This sensor can be used in weather stations and for altitude estimations.

libraries.name: SparkFun Temperature Sensor - STTS22H
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: This library is for the SparkFun Temperature Sensor - STTS22H
libraries.paragraph: This library breaks out all functionality of the STTS22H Temperature Sensor by STMicroelectronics.

libraries.name: SparkFun TLC5940
libraries.author: Alex Leone <acleone~AT~gmail.com>, SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the TLC5940 IC.
libraries.paragraph: The TLC5940 gives the user 16 channel PWM control and can be daisy chained over the serial interface. This library works with the SparkFun LED Driver Breakout and the SparkFun PWM Shield.

libraries.name: SparkFun TMAG5273 Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: A library to drive the Texas Instruments hall-effect sensor TMAG5273.
libraries.paragraph: The TMAG5273 is a low-power linear 3D Hall-effect sensor designed for a wide range of industrial and personal electronics applications

libraries.name: SparkFun TMP102 Breakout
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: A library to drive the Texas Instruments TMP102 using I2C.
libraries.paragraph: Communicates with the TMP102 over I2C to quickly integrate a temperature sensor into your project.

libraries.name: SparkFun Toolkit
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: A utility library that other SparkFun libraries can take advantage of.
libraries.paragraph: The SparkFun Toolkit provides a common set of core functionality for use across the SparkFun Arduino Driver library. Instead of each device driver library implementing a communication layers, error types and interface, the SparkFun Toolkit library is used.

libraries.name: SparkFun TouchInput Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Master library to handle user input through touchscreens
libraries.paragraph: This library provides common ways to handle user input from touch panels/screens. Create a touch input "device" as a combination of a hardware driver and "elements" like buttons, handles, and sliders. Create custom elements to interact with such as dials, gestures, and more.

libraries.name: SparkFun TouchInput Driver FT5xx6
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: A driver library for using FT5xx6 devices, compatible with the SparkFun TouchInput library
libraries.paragraph: This library allows for control of FT5xx6 capacitive touchscreen drivers. It is possible to either read the touch locations directly or use the SparkFun TouchInput compatible wrapper.

libraries.name: SparkFun TPA2016D2 Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the TPA2016D2 Stereo Class D Amp
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the SparkFun Qwiic Speaker Amp. Connect to the speaker amp via QWIIC, and easily adjust all of its available settings including volume and output audio level compression!

libraries.name: SparkFun TSL2561
libraries.author: Mike Grusin@SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: An Arduino Library for the TSL2561 Luminosity Sensor Breakout from SparkFun Electronics.
libraries.paragraph: Via I2C communication, the sensor conducts specific light ranges from 0.1-40k+ Lux.

libraries.name: SparkFun Tsunami Super WAV Trigger Qwiic
libraries.author: Robertsonics, SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: A library to control the SparkFun Tsunami Super WAV Trigger Qwiic.
libraries.paragraph: Communicates with the Tsunami over I<sup>2</sup>C via Qwiic cable to control audio playback, volume, output selection and much more.

libraries.name: SparkFun u-blox Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: DEPRECATED Library for I2C and Serial Communication with u-blox modules
libraries.paragraph:
Please note: this library is deprecated. Please migrate to v2.0. You can find the migration instructions here.

An Arduino Library to enable both I2C and Serial communication for both NMEA reception and binary UBX sending to u-blox modules. Useful for interfacing to the SparkFun GPS-RTK2 ZED-F9P, SparkFun GPS-RTK NEO-M8P-2, the SparkFun SAM-M8Q, and the SparkFun ZOE-M8Q. Library also works with other u-blox based boards.

The ZED-F9P and NEO-M8P-2 modules are top-of-the-line modules for high accuracy GNSS and GPS location solutions including RTK. The ZED-F9P is unique in that it is capable of both rover and base station operations allowing the module to become a base station and produce RTCM 3.x correction data.

libraries.name: SparkFun u-blox Cellular Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for u-blox cellular modules

libraries.name: SparkFun u-blox GNSS Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for I2C, Serial and SPI Communication with u-blox GNSS modules
libraries.paragraph:
An Arduino Library to support the full range of u-blox GNSS modules, using both NMEA and UBX protocols over I2C, Serial and SPI. Useful for interfacing to the SparkFun GPS-RTK2 ZED-F9P, SparkFun GPS-RTK NEO-M8P-2, SparkFun SAM-M8Q, SparkFun ZOE-M8Q and all the other SparkFun u-blox GNSS Breakouts.

The ZED-F9P and NEO-M8P-2 modules are top-of-the-line modules for high accuracy GNSS and GPS location solutions including RTK. The ZED-F9P is unique in that it is capable of both rover and base station operations allowing the module to become a base station and produce RTCM 3.x correction data.

Need support for RTK NTRIP Caster services like RTK2go, Emlid Caster and Skylark? This library has functions, callbacks and tried-and-tested examples to let you push RTCM correction data to your module seamlessly!

libraries.name: SparkFun u-blox GNSS v3
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for I2C, Serial and SPI Communication with u-blox GNSS modules
libraries.paragraph:
An Arduino Library to support the latest u-blox GNSS modules, using both NMEA and UBX protocols over I2C, Serial and SPI.

Important note: this version uses the u-blox Configuration Interface to detect and configure the module. It is not backward-compatible with older modules like the M8.

Useful for interfacing to the SparkFun GPS-RTK2 ZED-F9P and SparkFun MAX-M10S Breakout.

libraries.name: SparkFun u-blox PointPerfect Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: The u-blox PointPerfect Library (SDK) in Arduino format
libraries.paragraph: The u-blox PointPerfect Library (SDK) in Arduino format

libraries.name: SparkFun u-blox SARA-R5 Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the u-blox SARA-R5 LTE-M / NB-IoT modules with secure cloud
libraries.paragraph:
An Arduino library for the u-blox SARA-R5 LTE-M / NB-IoT modules with secure cloud, as used on the SparkFun MicroMod Asset Tracker and the SparkFun LTE GNSS Breakout - SARA-R5.

v1.1 has had a thorough update and includes new features and examples. This library now supports up to 7 simultaneous TCP or UDP sockets. There are new examples to show how to play ping pong with both TCP and UDP sockets.

v1.1 also supports binary data transfers correctly. There are new examples showing how you can integrate this library with the SparkFun u-blox GNSS Arduino Library, to use the SARA-R5 to: download AssistNow Online and Offline data and push it to the GNSS; open a connection to a NTRIP Caster (such as RTK2go, Skylark or Emlid Caster) and push RTK correction data to the GNSS.

libraries.name: SparkFun UM980 Triband RTK GNSS Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Library for Serial Communication and Configuration of the UM980
libraries.paragraph: This is a library to control Unicore GNSS receivers, with a focus on the UM980 Triband receiver. Other receivers in the same family should work: UM982, UM960, UM960L, etc. The UM980 is a 1408-Channel GNSS Receiver based on the Nebulas IV™ that is able to simultaneously track GPS L1/L2/L5, GLONASS L1/L2/L3, Galileo E1/E5a/E5b/E6, Beidou B1I/B2I/B3I/B1C/B2a/B2b, QZSS L1/L2/L5, and SBAS. This library is ideal for interfacing to the SparkFun Triband GNSS RTK Breakout - UM980.

libraries.name: SparkFun USB Hub Qwiic USB251x
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Configure the PID/VID and power consumption settings on the USB2514X USB Hub.
libraries.paragraph: Communicates with the USB2514B, USB2513B, or USB2512XB over I<sup>2</sup>C to quickly integrate a USB hub into your project. Downstream current limits can be set, vendor/product/device IDs can be set, and ports can be disabled and/or remapped.

libraries.name: SparkFun VCNL4040 Proximity Sensor Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Library for the SparkFun Qwiic Proximity Sensor 20cm - VCNL4040
libraries.paragraph: The VCNL4040 is a simple IR presence and ambient light sensor. This sensor is excellent for detecting if something has appeared in front of the sensor. We often see this type of sensor on automatic towel dispensers, automatic faucets, etc. You can detect objects qualitatively up to 20cm away. This means you can detect if something is there, and if it is closer or further away since the last reading, but it's difficult to say it is 7.2cm away. If you need quantitative distance readings (for example sensing that an object is 177mm away) check out the SparkFun Time of Flight (ToF) sensors with mm accuracy.

libraries.name: SparkFun VEML6075 Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the VEML6075 on the SparkFun Qwiic UV Sensor
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the VEML6075 UV sensor. This library configures the sensor, reads UVA, and UVB values, and calculates a UV index output.

libraries.name: SparkFun VEML7700 Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the VEML7700 Ambient Light Sensor
libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the VEML7700 ambient light sensor. The SparkFun Qwiic VEML7700 Ambient Light Sensor provides accurate, 16-bit ambient light readings from 0 to 167,000 lux via the I2C interface. This miniature sensor (6.8mm x 3.0mm x 2.5mm) features a high-sensitivity photodiode, a low-noise amplifier, and a 16-bit analog-to-digital (A/D) converter. Its unshifted 7-bit I2C address is 0x10. NOTE: Version 2.0 and above of this library is not completely backward compatable with the original version 1.0 SparkX version.

libraries.name: SparkFun VKey Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Arduino Library for interfacing the SparkFun VKey Voltage Keypad.
libraries.paragraph: Arduino Library for interfacing the SparkFun VKey Voltage Keypad (https://www.sparkfun.com/products/12080). Gives the user access to a 12 switch keypad using only a few I/O pins.

libraries.name: SparkFun VL53L1X 4m Laser Distance Sensor
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Library for the SparkFun Qwiic 4m Distance Sensor - VL53L1X
libraries.paragraph: The VL53L1X is the latest Time Of Flight (ToF) sensor to be released. It uses a VCSEL (vertical cavity surface emitting laser) to emit a class 1 IR laser and time the reflection to the target. What does all this mean? You can measure the distance to an object up to 4 meters away with millimeter resolution! That’s pretty incredible. We’ve found the precision of the sensor to be 1mm but the accuracy is around +/-5mm. Available at: https://www.sparkfun.com/products/14667

libraries.name: SparkFun VL53L5CX Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: Distance sensing (VL53L5CX) with 64 pixels up to 4 meters at 15Hz.
libraries.paragraph: The SparkFun Qwiic ToF Imager is state of the art, 64 pixel Time-of-Flight (ToF), multizone 4 meter ranging sensor with milimeter resolution built around the VL53L5CX from ST. This library supports reading distances up to 4m across all 64 sensors at up to 15Hz. Multiple sensors *can* be daisy-chained for additional readings.

libraries.name: SparkFun VL6180 Sensor
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: The VL6180 combines an IR emitter, a range sensor, and an ambient light sensor together for you to easily use and communicate with via an I2C interface.
libraries.paragraph: Library allows you to read distance and light outputs from the sensor, outputting the data via a serial connection.

libraries.name: SparkFun WAV Trigger Pro Qwiic
libraries.author: Robertsonics, SparkFun Electronics
libraries.sentence: A library to control the SparkFun WAV Trigger Pro using the Qwiic interface.
libraries.paragraph: Communicates with the WAV Trigger Pro over I<sup>2</sup>C via Qwiic cable to control audio playback, volume, and much more.

libraries.name: SparkFun WiseChip HUD
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for controlling the Transparent OLED Heads-Up Display from WiseChip
libraries.paragraph: Designed for use in vehicle heads-up displays, this OLED panel is brilliant in the dark but easily visible in daylight. The display is “area colored” meaning that while no one segment can change colors, there are different colored segments on the display. Our Qwiic breakout board allows you to easily control the display using the I²C protocol and includes a voltage step-up to generate the panel’s 12v driving voltage from Qwiic’s 3.3v bus.

libraries.name: SparkFun WM8960 Arduino Library
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>

libraries.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the SparkFun WM8960 Breakout. Connect to the CODEC via QWIIC, and easily adjust all of its available settings including volume and output audio level compression!

libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>

libraries.paragraph: This is the SparkFun library for the Acconeer Entry+ Module XM125 with the A121 60GHz Pulsed Coherent Radar sensor and I2C interface. NOTE: Version 2.0 or greater of this library is not backward compatible with version 1 - the library object has changed - see examples

libraries.name: SparkFun ZX Distance and Gesture Sensor
libraries.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>

libraries.paragraph: The ZX Distance and Gesture Sensor is sensor capable of sensing an object's distance from the sensor and its location between the IR LEDs.

libraries.name: SparkFun_FS3000_Arduino_Library

libraries.paragraph: Reads data back from sensor and checks the checksum. Supports both FS3000-1005 and FS3000-1015 versions.

libraries.paragraph: This library adds the W5500 as a physical Ethernet interface for the ESP32. The HTTP(S) methods are provided by WiFiServer and WiFiClient. Works great with me-no-dev's ESPAsyncWebServer.

libraries.paragraph: Seeed Studio's Spartan Edge Accelerator board includes an ESP32 MCU in addition to the Xilinx Spartan FPGA. This library provides infrastructure to support using the ESP32 to load .bit files from the SD card to the FPGA each time the board boots.

Moreover, they are much more precise (certainly depending on clock frequency accuracy) than other ISR-based or software-based PWM using millis() or micros(). This CO2 reacts with water to create carbonic acid, and afterwards further products, which makes the ocean water more acidic. This process is known as ocean acidification. Over the next century ocean water is predicted to become 2.5 times more acidic. It is imperative that we understand how ocean acidification will impact marine organisms and ecosystems. Because the oceans contain over 99% of the habitable space on earth, and much of the planet’s biodiversity this will be a massive undertaking. Unfortunately, the equipment needed to perform ocean acidification research is expensive, restricting this work to a relatively few well-funded labs. The goal of the Open Acidification Project is to create inexpensive open-source tools to conduct ocean acidification research and ultimately greatly increase the amount of quality ocean acidification research that can be accomplished.

libraries.name: WCB_Client
libraries.author: Greg Hulette
libraries.sentence: Client library for joining a Wireless Communication Board (WCB) ESP-NOW network.
libraries.paragraph: Allows any ESP32-based device to participate as a native peer in a WCB network. Supports unicast and broadcast text commands with automatic fragmentation for long commands (e.g. saving large stored sequences), raw binary forwarding for Pololu/Maestro servo packets via WCBStream, ETM heartbeat and ACK tracking, board online/offline status callbacks, and communication with an out-of-band special peer such as NaviCore via enableSpecialPeer(). A raw-packet hook (onRawPacket/sendRawPacket) lets custom protocols — such as firmware OTA — ride the same ESP-NOW mesh. setIdentity() advertises the device over WDP so WCBs discover it by name and firmware version automatically (the mesh twin of the serial WDP-DA device-announce model), and onNeighbor()/getNeighbor() consume the same WDP adverts to learn every WCB and client on the mesh — alias, firmware, capabilities, controller link and Maestro IDs. With auto-join (on by default) the device also registers regular WCBs it hears as ESP-NOW peers live and remembers them across reboots, so it discovers the fleet once and never needs wcb_quantity to cover it.

libraries.name: WcbCmd

Turns the WCB ";"-command verbs (;M Maestro, ;A MP3, ;L WLED, ;H HCR) into each device's native serial wire protocol, identically on any board. Compiled by BOTH the WCB firmware and a WCB_Client host (e.g. NaviCore) so the SAME command produces the SAME device bytes whether it is reached across the mesh over ESP-NOW (a WCB parses it) or out a host-local serial port (the host parses it). The library is pure translation (verb/action -> native bytes on an injected Stream); all routing, config, NVS and ESP-NOW relay stay in the firmware. Ships the Maestro (;M), MP3 (;A), WLED (;L) and HCR (;H) modules.

libraries.name: Xbox 360 Controller LEDs

libraries.name: XC_GUI

libraries.name: XC_SR04

libraries.name: XDigit7Segment_74HC595

Works on AVR, ESP32, RP2040, SAMD, STM32, and any board with a Serial port. Includes a C++ wrapper class (XelpCLI) for easy Arduino integration.

libraries.name: Xeno Language

libraries.name: XENSIV 3D Magnetic Sensor TLx493D
libraries.author: Infineon Technologies

libraries.name: XENSIV Angle Sensor TLx5012B
libraries.author: Infineon Technologies
libraries.sentence: This library enables the Infineon XENSIV(TM) TLx5012B magnetic angle sensor.
libraries.paragraph: The XENSIV(TM) TLx5012B is a pre-calibrated 360 degree angle sensor that detects the orientation of a magnetic field, including a sophisticated digital signal processor. The sensor is available as Kit 2Go and as bulk chip.

libraries.name: XENSIV BGT60TR13C Radar Sensor
libraries.author: Infineon Technologies
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the Infineon XENSIV BGT60TR13C radar sensor
libraries.paragraph: The BGT60TR13C is a 60 GHz radar sensor with Antennas in Package (AIP) in an L-shaped array. Its built-in Finite-State Machine (FSM) manages FMCW frequency sweeps, data acquisition, and sample storage into the internal FIFO memory, while optimized power modes and DC duty cycling minimize power consumption. The sensor is configured and controlled via a standard SPI interface, allowing for easy integration into various applications.

libraries.name: XENSIV Digital Pressure Sensor
libraries.author: Infineon Technologies
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for the Infineon XENSIV(TM) Digital Pressure Sensors (DPS3xx).
libraries.paragraph: The XENSIV(TM) barometric pressure sensor series (DPS3xx) offers excellent pressure noise performance and high stability over temperature.

libraries.name: XENSIV PAS CO2
libraries.author: Infineon Technologies
libraries.sentence: C/C++ library for Infineon XENSIV™ PAS CO2 sensor
libraries.paragraph: C/C++ library for Infineon XENSIV™ Photoacoustic Spectroscopy (PAS) CO2 miniaturized sensor

libraries.name: XGZP6897D

libraries.name: XInput

libraries.name: XLOT-QuadSwitch

libraries.name: XLR8ADC

libraries.name: XLR8AddrPack

libraries.name: XLR8BuildTemplate

libraries.name: XLR8Core
libraries.author: Alorium Technology
libraries.sentence: OpenXLR8 Core components
libraries.paragraph: With these components, users can integrate their own designs into XLR8 platform using the Alorium Technology OpenXLR8 flow. For optimal compatibilty, ensure XLR8Core and XLR8BuildTemplate libraries are updated to the same version number.

libraries.name: XLR8DigitalIO
libraries.author: Alorium Technology

libraries.paragraph: Takes advantage of hardware acceleration available in Alorium Technology's XLR8 product. For use with an XLR8 Snō board to access the extra pins.

libraries.name: XLR8DMem

libraries.name: XLR8Float

libraries.paragraph: Takes advantage of hardware acceleration available in Alorium Technology's XLR8 product.

libraries.author: Alorium Technology

libraries.name: XLR8LFSR

libraries.name: XLR8NeoPixel

Doesn't use AVR memory, doesn't require disabling interrupts during show() routine, doesn't lose resolution on RGB values when setting brightness low then high. Does provide an awesome drop-in replacement for the standard NeoPixel library.

libraries.name: XLR8PID
libraries.author: Alorium Technology
libraries.sentence: Arduino library for hardware accelerated PID control.
libraries.paragraph: Takes advantage of hardware acceleration available in Alorium Technology's XLR8 product. For use with an XLR8 board with the PID XB loaded on it.

libraries.name: XLR8Pong

libraries.name: XLR8Quadrature

libraries.sentence: Arduino library for hardware accelerated quadrature encoder control.
libraries.paragraph: Takes advantage of hardware acceleration available in Alorium Technology's XLR8 product. For use with an XLR8 board with the quadrature XB loaded on it.

libraries.name: XLR8RC

libraries.paragraph: Captures outputs from an RC receiver (the signals that go to servos) and outputs a 16 bit integer representing the pulse width (in microseconds)

libraries.name: XLR8Servo
libraries.author: Alorium Technology

libraries.paragraph: It uses a set of dedicated custom hardware timers instead of the microcontroller's timer. The library can control up to 20 servos accurately without relying on microcontroller interrupt handling.

libraries.name: XLR8SPI

libraries.name: XLR8USB

This library can control a number of servos.
Uses on-board Hardware PWM timers: the library can control as many servos as the board supports (currently 4 to 23 dependent on board).
On the Infineon XMC4700 Relax you can control up to 23 servos.

libraries.name: XMLWriter

libraries.name: XPowersLib

libraries.name: XPT2046_Bitbang

libraries.name: XPT2046_Touchscreen

libraries.name: XRA1405

libraries.name: xrp-style-wpilib-comms

The goal is for this library to be compatible with the protocol meant for XRP robots running the xrp-wpilib-firmware.

libraries.name: XSegment_lib

libraries.name: xsens_mti

libraries.name: YAAWS
libraries.author: M Hotchin
libraries.sentence: Yet Another Arduino Web Server
libraries.paragraph: Simple webserver, supports GET/HEAD and POST.  Designed to reduce blocking as much as possible, by splitting and servicing requests in chunks.

libraries.name: YACL

libraries.sentence: Yet Another CBOR Library.
libraries.paragraph: A library to encode and decode CBOR messages (RFC 7049).

libraries.name: Yaesu FT857D CAT

libraries.sentence: Simulate a Yaesu FT-857D radio from the CAT point of view.
libraries.paragraph: This library will make your sketch behave as a Yaesu FT-857D radio, and will give you basic control over it via CAT serial commands.

libraries.name: YAMLDuino
libraries.author: tobozo <tobozo@users.noreply.github.com>
libraries.sentence: A simple and efficient YAML library for embedded C++
libraries.paragraph: YAMLDuino is syntax friendly with ArduinoJson and cJSON, supports ✔ serialization, ✔ deserialization, ✔ conversion

libraries.name: YAPID
libraries.author: Auralius Manurung
libraries.sentence: YAPID is another PID library for Arduino.
libraries.paragraph: YAPID focuses on more accurate implementations through detailed discretization techniques and result comparisons against MATLAB Simulink.

libraries.name: YASM
libraries.author: Bricofoy <bricofoy@free.fr>
libraries.sentence: Easy finite state machine creation and management library
libraries.paragraph: A library that helps creating finite state machines based on function pointers. Can run concurrently any number of states machines. Provide all required basic timing functions to easily create automatons. Can also be used as a (very) basic scheduler.

libraries.name: yatest
libraries.author: Simon Lehmann <simon.lmn@gmail.com>
libraries.sentence: Lightweight unit testing framework and Arduino mocks for host-based testing.
libraries.paragraph: Provides a minimal test framework (Expect, TestRunner) and comprehensive Arduino API mocks (Arduino.h, String, Stream) for native compilation and testing. Tests run on development machines without hardware.

libraries.name: YDLidar
libraries.author: George Papamichail
libraries.sentence: An Arduino library for The YDLiDar GS2
libraries.paragraph: The YDLiDar library provides a robust interface for the YDLidar GS2, enabling easy communication and data retrieval. It supports multiple GS2 LiDARs and allows users to configure and retrieve detailed measurements from each connected device.

libraries.name: Yeelight
libraries.author: AlexMihai <tapirlan.alexandru184@gmail.com>

libraries.paragraph: This library provides functions to control Yeelight smart lights and devices via WiFi.

libraries.name: Yet Another Arduino Debounce Library

libraries.sentence: An asynchronous Arduino Library for debouncing

libraries.name: Yet Another Arduino PcInt Library
libraries.author: keestux, SODAQ, GabrielNotman, Paulo Costa
libraries.sentence: A library to support Pin Change Interruptions (PCINT) on AVR Arduinos

libraries.name: Yet Another Arduino Wiegand Library

libraries.name: YetAnotherButtonLibrary

libraries.name: YetAnotherRotaryEncoder

libraries.paragraph: Doesn't need debouncing circuitry and can work with a single interrupt or polling.

libraries.name: YF-S201 Water Flow

libraries.paragraph: This library provides an easy-to-use interface to measure water flow rate and calculate total volume

libraries.paragraph: This library provides an easy way to read button states and send vibration commands for PS2 controllers using UART communication. It includes methods for initializing the library, reading data, and processing button states.

libraries.name: YFPS2UARTLib

libraries.name: Yfrobot I2C Line Follow Sensor Library

libraries.name: Yfrobot VALON-I3 Library

libraries.name: ZenoPCB
libraries.author: ZENOPCB ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD <infor@zenopcb.vn>
libraries.sentence: Declarative IoT library for ESP32, ESP8266, UNO R4 WiFi and STM32 — WiFi provisioning, MQTT, OTA, Modbus, ZSignals, alarms, schedules and irrigation.
libraries.paragraph: Single-entry-point library for the ZenoPCB IoT platform. v0.4.0 introduces a declarative ZSignal API: DEVICE_TO_CLOUD / CLOUD_TO_DEVICE / ZENO_EVERY macros self-register at file scope, so the setup() chain stays a single `wifi().device().begin()` line. Provides WiFi captive-portal provisioning, MQTT (with optional TLS), HTTP OTA with rollback, Modbus RTU/TCP with register-polling and MQTT control, ZSignals (Z0..Z254) custom telemetry/control, edge alarm rules, schedule execution, irrigation scenarios, and diagnostics reporting. Vendors ArduinoJson, PubSubClient, TinyGSM, Preferences, FlashStorage and StreamDebugger so a single install is enough. Optional features are gated by build flags: ZENOPCB_ENABLE_TLS, ZENOPCB_ENABLE_ETHERNET, ZENOPCB_ENABLE_CELLULAR.
